items.title: 科技巨頭AI魔法正在褪色 華爾街年終行情面臨艱難考驗
items.title_en: Tech Giants' AI Magic Fades as Wall Street Faces Tough Year‑End Test
paras: 華爾街原本期待，在人工智慧(AI)投資題材支撐下，科技巨頭財報可以帶動第3季財報預期上修，沒想到本周揭露的業績表現不如預期，這股期待如今開始消退，整體市場也開始顯露疲態，讓今年最後兩個月的行情增添變數。
Alphabet(GOOGL-US)周四(29日)股價暴跌近13%，創上市以來史上最大單日跌幅，加上科技巨頭同業微軟(MSFT-US)股價小幅下跌，拖累美股大幅走低。
標普500指數(SPX)10月估僅小幅上漲1%，9月下跌0.45%。那斯達克綜合指數(COMP)10月則估跌2.2%。
目前已公布財報的「科技七巨頭」業績令人失望，而接下來幾周即將公布財報的企業，也未能讓市場清楚判斷AI投資的實際成效。這顯示AI題材對市場的影響力正逐漸減弱。
同一時間，市場背景中的重大風險正在累積，包括伊朗戰爭、聯準會(Fed)可能被迫升息，以及美國消費者開始感受到通膨加速與就業不安全感揮之不去的衝擊。這些因素都讓股市在多頭行情邁入第五年之際面臨挑戰。
Fifth Third Wealth Advisors投資長Chris Osmond說：「AI交易題材不一定已經失靈，但市場關注的焦點正從資本支出，擴大到執行能力與商業化變現。從長期來看，這是比較健康的發展，儘管可能造成更大的波動，也會讓大型科技公司的股價表現出現更明顯的差異。」
Questar Capital Partners投資長Richard Reyle認為，科技股交易已來到轉折點，「這勢必會造就贏家與輸家」。
他表示：「我們現在開始看得出，哪些企業在AI上的支出合理，哪些企業並非如此。科技業財報季傳達的訊息很簡單：資本支出增加，加上大規模發行股票，會引發投資人撤離相關股票。」

科技股財報驚喜不如預期 AI投資開始考驗變現能力

標普500科技類股指數(IXT)過去一個月下跌近3%，較6月初高點回落約4.8%。這使大盤受到打壓，標普500指數過去五個月僅上漲1.4%。
第3季財報季迄今已公布財報企業略高於一半，根據LSEG數據，獲利超越市場預期的幅度平均為4.5%，遠低於第4季平均約7.7%的財報「驚喜」幅度。
LSEG數據顯示，科技類股的財報驚喜幅度為4.7%，包含Alphabet在內的通訊服務類股則為負1.5%。
以企業業績不出色來解釋或許有失公允，科技業這季獲利可能仍占標普500指數整體獲利中約一半，第4季預估也將占相近比重。但科技業已不再像過去那樣，為市場帶來額外的強勁推力，這正是令人擔憂之處。
凱投宏觀(Capital Economics)金融市場首席經濟顧問John Higgins說：「我們的基本情境是，標普500指數獲利從AI革命於2002年11月開始以來就大幅成長的趨勢，到了明年將無法延續。我們懷疑這股成長動能將有一部分遭到逆轉，進而拖累整體表現。」
他說：「考量過去四年來，科技業與整體AI投資題材一直支撐美國市場，這種可能性就令人擔憂。再加上伊朗戰爭造成能源價格動盪，並持續推升通膨壓力，情況就更令人憂心。」

通膨與升息風險升高 油價恐再推升市場壓力

聯準會(Fed)本周成功避開在10月升息，但通膨數據和穩健的預期經濟成長速度，可能讓Fed無法在12月繼續按兵不動。
Plante Moran Financial投資長Jim Baird說：「經濟成長強勁，民間內需更為強勁，裁員人數仍低，通膨則仍居高不下。你還需要看到什麼，才會進一步收緊貨幣政策？」
油價目前已穩居每桶100美元以上。若在11月3日的美國期中選舉結束後，美國與以色列決定對伊朗發動更大規模、破壞力更強的攻擊，油價可能進一步攀升。
這場期中選舉也可能比傳統風險指標目前所顯示的更容易撼動市場。民調顯示，民主黨可能取得顯著進展並重新掌控眾議院，但參議院是否也會由民主黨取得多數，仍有變數。
RBC Capital Markets美股策略主管Lori Calvasina表示：「我們認為，兩黨分掌國會對股市而言屬於中性至小幅正面事件：民主黨全面勝出屬於中性至負面事件，共和黨全面勝出則屬於正面事件。」
她補充說：「不過，重要的是持續關注投票率，以及出口民調所反映的選民投票原因，了解選民為何選擇支持某一方。」

年底衝刺時間有限 標普500挑戰8000點難度升高

這些潛在逆風接連浮現，對過去四年大多依賴科技股支撐的市場而言，是一大考驗。
從現在到年底還有44個交易日，市場仍有許多工作要做。假設標普500指數要達到華爾街堅定預測的8000點，就必須在剩餘交易日平均每天上漲約6.8點。
但今年以來，該指數每日平均漲幅約為4.4點，而在科技股與AI投資題材迅速褪色的情況下，要一個動能已所剩無幾的市場達成這項目標，恐怕有些困難。
paras_en: Wall Street had originally hoped that AI‑driven investment themes would lift tech‑giant earnings and prompt an upward revision of third‑quarter forecasts, but this week’s disappointing results have dampened that optimism, leaving the broader market showing signs of fatigue and adding uncertainty to the final two months of the year.

Alphabet (GOOGL‑US) saw its stock plunge nearly 13% on Thursday (the 29th), marking the largest single‑day drop since its listing, and Microsoft (MSFT‑US) also slipped slightly, pulling U.S. equities sharply lower.
The S&P 500 (SPX) is projected to rise only about 1% in October after a 0.45% decline in September, while the Nasdaq Composite (COMP) is expected to fall 2.2% for the month.

The earnings already reported by the “Big Seven” tech companies have been disappointing, and the upcoming reports in the next few weeks do not give the market a clear view of AI’s real impact, indicating that the AI theme’s market influence is waning.

At the same time, major background risks are building up, including the Iran war, a possible forced rate hike by the Fed, and U.S. consumers feeling the sting of accelerating inflation and lingering job‑security concerns, all of which challenge the market as it enters its fifth year of a bull run.

Chris Osmond, Chief Investment Officer at Fifth Third Wealth Advisors, said: “The AI trade theme may not have completely broken down yet, but market focus is shifting from capital spending to execution capability and commercialisation. In the long run that’s a healthier development, even if it brings more volatility and makes the performance of large‑cap tech stocks diverge more sharply.”
Richard Reyle, Chief Investment Officer at Questar Capital Partners, believes tech‑stock trading has reached a turning point, “which will inevitably create winners and losers.”

He added: “We’re now starting to see which companies’ AI spending is justified and which isn’t. The message from this tech earnings season is simple: higher capex combined with large‑scale share issuances will trigger investors to pull out of the affected stocks.”

Tech‑stock earnings fell short of expectations, putting AI’s monetisation to the test. The S&P 500 Information Technology Index (IXT) has dropped nearly 3% over the past month, retreating about 4.8% from its early‑June peak, dragging the broader market down as the S&P 500 has risen only 1.4% over the last five months.

To date, slightly more than half of the companies in the Q3 earnings season have reported, and LSEG data show that earnings beat the market by an average of 4.5%, far below the roughly 7.7% “surprise” average seen in Q4 historically.
LSEG data indicate that the earnings surprise for tech stocks is 4.7%, while communication‑services stocks—including Alphabet—registered a negative 1.5% surprise.

Attributing the weak results solely to company performance may be unfair; tech earnings this quarter likely still account for about half of total S&P 500 earnings, and a similar share is expected in Q4. However, tech is no longer providing the extra thrust it once did, which is concerning.

John Higgins, Chief Economic Adviser for Capital Economics, said: “Our baseline scenario is that the profit growth the S&P 500 has enjoyed since the AI revolution began in November 2002 will not be sustainable next year. We suspect part of that growth engine will reverse, dragging overall performance down.”

He added: “Given that tech and the broader AI theme have been supporting the U.S. market for the past four years, that prospect is worrisome. Add the Iran war‑induced energy price volatility and continued inflation pressure, and the outlook looks even bleaker.”

Inflation and rate‑rise risks are rising, and oil prices could further pressure markets. The Fed managed to avoid a rate hike in October, but inflation data and a solid growth outlook may prevent it from staying on hold through December.

Jim Baird, Chief Investment Officer at Plante Moran Financial, said: “Economic growth is strong, private demand is robust, layoffs remain low, and inflation stays high. What else do you need to see before tightening monetary policy further?”

Oil is currently trading above $100 a barrel. If, after the U.S. midterm elections on November 3, the United States and Israel decide to launch a larger, more destructive attack on Iran, oil prices could climb even higher.

The midterms may also prove more market‑shaking than traditional risk gauges suggest. Polls indicate the Democrats could make significant gains and retake the House, but whether they also capture a Senate majority remains uncertain.

Lori Calvasina, Head of U.S. Equity Strategy at RBC Capital Markets, said: “We view a split Congress as a neutral‑to‑slightly‑positive event for equities; a full Democratic sweep as neutral‑to‑negative; and a full Republican sweep as positive.”
She added: “What matters is monitoring voter turnout and the reasons voters give for their choices, as reflected in exit polls, to understand the drivers behind their decisions.”

The limited time left in the year makes the S&P 500’s push toward 8,000 points increasingly difficult. These emerging headwinds pose a major test for a market that has relied heavily on tech stocks for the past four years.

With 44 trading days remaining until year‑end, the market still has work to do. To hit the Wall Street‑forecast 8,000 level, the S&P 500 would need to average about 6.8 points of gain per day for the rest of the year.
So far this year the index has averaged roughly 4.4 points per day, and with tech stocks and AI themes fading rapidly, achieving that target in a market with dwindling momentum looks doubtful.

items.title: 美股亮罕見警訊！關鍵指標飆近70年新高 兩場大熊市曾出現
items.title_en: U.S. Stocks Light Rare Warning! Key Indicator Soars to Near 70-Year High After Two Bear Markets
paras: 美股罕見警示燈亮了！衡量優質股與低品質股相對表現的「優質減劣質因子」（QMJ），今年7月大漲14.3%，創1957年以來最大單月漲幅。歷史上，單月漲幅第二、第三大的時點，分別落在2000年11月與2008年10月，正值網路泡沫與金融海嘯熊市期間，如今指標再度飆升，引發市場戒心。
這次警訊出現在低品質股經歷史上最長、最猛烈的領漲行情之後。投資研究機構Porter and Company創辦人F. Porter Stansberry認為，人工智慧（AI）狂熱催生的投機行情已出現轉折，直言「現在是謹慎的時候了」。
低品質股狂飆 AI熱潮推波助瀾
這輪低品質股跑贏優質股的行情，從2023年11月延續至2026年6月，持續時間與幅度均創紀錄。期間，做多美國最高品質企業、做空最低品質企業的投資組合累計虧損36%，是QMJ自1957年有紀錄以來最差的一段表現。
截至2026年5月的12個月，也是69年紀錄中，優質股相對表現最弱的12個月。QMJ在2023年至2025年連續三年虧損，今年前八個月仍下跌3.8%，反映投資人追逐低品質股的力道。
AI熱潮是這波行情的主要推手。根據彭博數據，高盛追蹤的虧損科技股籃子，今年前五個月大漲57%，遠超標普500指數同期的11%。成分企業逾四分之一虧損的羅素2000小型股指數，上半年也上漲22.7%，漲幅超過大盤兩倍。
Stansberry將這波行情稱為「科技驅動的垃圾股泡沫」，並指出，其規模已是有紀錄以來最大。
警示指標看什麼？獲利、成長與安全
QMJ由AQR資本管理公司創辦人Cliff Asness與同事Andrea Frazzini、Lasse Heje Pedersen於2013年提出，相關論文於2019年發表，美國市場數據可追溯至1957年7月。
這項指標以獲利能力、成長性及安全性衡量企業品質。其中，獲利能力採用六項指標，成長性觀察過去五年每股盈餘變化，安全性則綜合股價波動、資產負債表穩健程度與股東權益報酬率的波動。
QMJ每月對美國上市股票評分，買進排名最高的30%企業，同時放空排名最低的30%，採市值加權並每月調整。因此，指標上漲代表優質股相對占上風，不等於整體股市上漲。
值得留意的是，QMJ完全不考慮估值，只衡量企業品質。從1957年7月至2026年8月，優質股平均每年跑贏低品質股3.6%，但短期仍可能長時間落後。
投機狂熱退燒 市場往往面臨調整
自1957年以來，QMJ曾經歷八次跌幅超過10%的下行週期。其中，由科技狂熱推動的典型案例，包括1960年代電子與電腦熱潮、1999年網路泡沫，以及2020年電動車、加密貨幣與遠距辦公熱潮。
這三次泡沫破裂後的兩年內，優質股分別跑贏低品質股28%、68%及41%；同期整體股市報酬分別為負4.5%、負23.5%與正6.4%。最後一次仍錄得正報酬，與比較基期落在疫情崩盤後低點有關。
不過，低品質股領漲並非一律意味泡沫。重大熊市過後，央行大量注入流動性，可能讓財務脆弱、瀕臨破產的企業得以存活，帶動股價從低點反彈。1970年代、1992年、2002年及2009年，都曾出現這類情況。
本輪行情的背景則不同。標普500在此期間持續創高，低品質股的強勢主要來自AI熱潮，並非熊市過後的復甦，也不是低估值帶動的反彈。
資金轉向優質股 投機股遭重擊
如今，市場風格已出現明顯變化。除了QMJ今年7月大漲14.3%，高盛追蹤的虧損科技股籃子第三季下跌11%；先前強勢的高投機性個股也遭重創，AST SpaceMobile(ASTS-US) 下跌56%，D-Wave Quantum(QBTS-US) 下跌52%。
相較之下，高品質消費股明顯回升。自6月30日以來，寶僑(PG-US) 上漲12.9%、可口可樂(KO-US) 上漲17.3%、Church & Dwight(CHDN-US) 上漲12.4%，高露潔棕欖(CL-US) 也上漲6.2%，均優於標普500同期的2.3%。
Stansberry提醒，QMJ過去兩次最顯著的單月漲勢，分別出現在2000年11月與2008年10月，這段歷史對照值得警惕。隨著低品質股領漲行情逆轉，他認為，投資布局向高品質、獲利能力強的企業傾斜，可能是當前較穩健的選擇。
paras_en: U.S. stocks have lit a rare warning light! The "Quality Minus Junk factor" (QMJ), which measures the relative performance of high‑quality versus low‑quality stocks, jumped 14.3% in July, the biggest single‑month gain since 1957. Historically, the second‑ and third‑largest monthly gains occurred in November 2000 and October 2008, during the dot‑com bubble and the financial‑crisis bear markets, and the indicator’s new surge is raising market caution.

The warning follows the longest and most intense rally ever seen for low‑quality stocks. Porter and Company founder F. Porter Stansberry says the AI‑driven speculative frenzy is turning a corner and bluntly advises, "Now is the time for caution."
Low‑quality stocks surge, fueled by the AI hype

This rally in which low‑quality stocks outperformed high‑quality stocks ran from November 2023 through June 2026, setting records for both duration and magnitude. Over that period, a long‑short portfolio that bought the highest‑quality U.S. firms and shorted the lowest‑quality firms lost 36%, the worst performance for the QMJ since records began in 1957.

The 12‑month period ending May 2026 also marks the weakest 12‑month relative performance of high‑quality stocks in the 69‑year record. The QMJ posted losses for three consecutive years from 2023 to 2025 and was down another 3.8% in the first eight months of this year, reflecting the strength of investors chasing low‑quality stocks.

The AI boom is the main driver of this rally. Bloomberg data show that the loss‑making tech‑stock basket tracked by Goldman Sachs surged 57% in the first five months of the year, far outpacing the S&P 500’s 11% gain over the same period. More than a quarter of the constituents of the Russell 2000 small‑cap index, which is dominated by loss‑making firms, rose 22.7% in the first half, more than double the broad market’s rise.
Stansberry calls this wave a "technology‑driven junk‑stock bubble" and notes that its size is the largest on record.
What does the warning indicator look at? Profitability, growth and safety

The QMJ was introduced in 2013 by Cliff Asness of AQR Capital Management together with Andrea Frazzini and Lasse Heje Pedersen, with the related paper published in 2019. U.S. market data for the factor go back to July 1957.

The metric evaluates corporate quality on profitability, growth and safety. Profitability is measured by six indicators, growth looks at five‑year earnings‑per‑share changes, and safety combines price volatility, balance‑sheet strength and equity‑return volatility.

Each month the QMJ scores all U.S. listed stocks, buying the top‑30% and shorting the bottom‑30%, using market‑cap weighting and rebalancing monthly. Therefore, a rise in the index means high‑quality stocks are relatively stronger, not that the overall market is up.

It is worth noting that the QMJ ignores valuation entirely and only measures quality. From July 1957 through August 2026, high‑quality stocks have outperformed low‑quality stocks by an average of 3.6% per year, though short‑term periods can see prolonged underperformance.
Speculative frenzy cools, markets often face corrections

Since 1957 the QMJ has experienced eight down‑turn cycles of more than 10% decline. Typical cases driven by tech hype include the 1960s electronics and computer boom, the 1999 dot‑com bubble, and the 2020 surges in electric vehicles, cryptocurrencies and remote‑work technologies.

In the two years after each of those three bubbles burst, high‑quality stocks outperformed low‑quality stocks by 28%, 68% and 41% respectively, while total market returns were –4.5%, –23.5% and +6.4%. The last episode still posted a positive return, partly because the base period was the post‑pandemic market low.

However, a rally led by low‑quality stocks does not always signal a bubble. After major bear markets, central‑bank liquidity injections can keep financially fragile, near‑bankrupt firms alive, prompting price rebounds from lows. Similar patterns occurred in the 1970s, 1992, 2002 and 2009.

The backdrop for the current rally is different. The S&P 500 kept making new highs during this span, and the strength of low‑quality stocks stems mainly from the AI boom, not from a post‑bear‑market recovery or a value‑driven bounce.
Funds shift to quality, speculative stocks take a hit

Today market style has shifted markedly. In addition to the QMJ’s 14.3% jump in July, Goldman Sachs’ loss‑making tech basket fell 11% in the third quarter, and previously strong high‑speculation stocks have been hammered – AST SpaceMobile (ASTS‑US) down 56% and D‑Wave Quantum (QBTS‑US) down 52%.

By contrast, high‑quality consumer stocks have clearly rebounded. Since June 30, Procter & Gamble (PG‑US) is up 12.9%, Coca‑Cola (KO‑US) up 17.3%, Church & Dwight (CHDN‑US) up 12.4% and Colgate‑Palmolive (CL‑US) up 6.2%, all outperforming the S&P 500’s 2.3% gain over the same period.

Stansberry warns that the QMJ’s two most pronounced single‑month spikes occurred in November 2000 and October 2008, and that history should serve as a caution. As the low‑quality rally reverses, he suggests tilting portfolios toward high‑quality, profit‑rich companies may be the more prudent current approach.

items.title: 英特爾股價狂瀉近3成！PC疲弱、代工大單未明 明年自由現金流恐轉負
items.title_en: Intel Stock Plummets Nearly 30% as Weak PC Demand and Unclear Foundry Outlook Weigh; Free Cash Flow May Turn Negative Next Year
paras: 英特爾(INTC-US) 資料中心營收創15年來最強成長，卻難掩PC走弱與代工前景未明的壓力。記憶體漲價壓抑換機需求，公司預估第四季客戶端營收將季減逾20%，外部代工大單仍無明確時程。財測遜於預期，加上明年資本支出將大增、自由現金流恐轉負，拖累股價周五(30日)盤中重挫近三成。
這次市場失望的重點，不在當季獲利，而在接下來的營運展望。PC放緩至少延續至明年上半年，代工仍持續虧損，明年資本支出又將大幅增加。即使伺服器訂單強勁，仍難抵銷市場對轉型進度與現金流的疑慮。
PC先走弱 第四季營收估再減逾兩成
以PC與筆電處理器為主的客戶端業務（CCPG），第三季營收80.97億美元，年減5%、季減9%，低於公司預期；營業利益22.85億美元，營業利益率約28%。
客戶端業務仍是英特爾最大的營收來源，但公司預估第四季營收將再季減逾20%。財務長辛斯納（Dave Zinsner）表示，PC市場放緩至少持續至明年上半年，庫存調整則至少延續至第一季。
英特爾預估，2026年PC整體潛在市場以出貨量計將萎縮約12%，其中下半年降幅超過20%；2027年可能再減少約10%。
記憶體漲價是壓抑需求的重要因素。資料中心仍願意支付更高價格取得記憶體，PC市場卻因整機成本上升，削弱消費者換機意願，連帶拖累處理器銷售。
摩根士丹利估計，客戶端業務持續惡化，將使市場對英特爾營收的共識預估面臨約30億至40億美元的下修壓力。
當季獲利超預期 下季財測卻落空
英特爾第三季營收165.13億美元，年增21%，大致符合市場預期的約165億美元；經調整每股盈餘0.52美元，優於市場預估的約0.40美元，也高於公司原先預測的約0.38美元。
然而，公司預估第四季營收僅150億至160億美元，低於市場預期的約171億美元；經調整每股盈餘估為0.25美元，同樣不及市場預估的約0.43美元。
以色列南部基亞特加特Fab 28廠本月初發生爆炸、停產約兩週，也衝擊部分10奈米伺服器產品供應。辛斯納表示，初步估計事故將使第四季營收減少約3億美元，毛利率下降約2個百分點，明年第一季營收可能受到類似影響。
多數晶圓報廢損失將列入第四季。不過，相較工廠事故，PC銷售疲弱才是第四季財測低於市場預期的主要原因。
代工被寄予厚望 客戶時程仍待交代
英特爾前執行長季辛格推動IDM 2.0策略，希望自家晶圓廠除了生產內部產品，也能承接外部訂單，並投入資金建廠、追趕先進製程。
陳立武上任後，市場一度猜測他會縮減代工業務以改善財務表現，但他持續將代工列為優先發展項目。公司8月增發股票籌資約230億美元後，市場也將期待寄託於供應改善、18A製程產能提升，以及外部客戶訂單落實。
然而，第三季代工業務營收66.97億美元，絕大部分仍來自內部訂單。外部收入雖季增1.18億美元至4.11億美元，主要由一次性客戶專案帶動，該部門營業虧損仍達18.53億美元。
財報電話會議上，美銀直接追問，外部客戶何時會從評估進入正式投片，也就是完成設計並交由晶圓廠製造，以及相關收入何時能納入財務預估。
陳立武未透露客戶細節，僅表示封裝業務未來兩季可能有客戶準備宣布消息；至於18A與14A，仍未提供明確時程或可供估算的收入數字。
先進製程能否換來大單 仍待驗證
SemiAnalysis指出，英特爾18A雖已出貨，電晶體密度並未領先台積電同級製程，高階GPU與I/O晶片仍須搭配台積電產能。
摩根士丹利認為，市場對英特爾代工的信心，主要押注14A製程於2028年或2029年落實，但目前外部客戶的大量生產承諾仍有限。
該行更擔心英特爾的結構性能力不足，認為若連自家產品需求都無法滿足，將不利於爭取外部客戶。對代工轉型而言，製程推出之後，能否取得持續且具規模的訂單，仍是重要考驗。
伺服器訂單強勁 供應卻跟不上
英特爾第三季資料中心與AI業務（DCAI）營收73.18億美元，年增78%、季增17%；營業利益30.39億美元，營業利益率約42%，獲利已超越客戶端業務。
陳立武表示，儘管短期PC產業面臨逆風，CPU需求依然強勁，目前首要任務是增加供應，滿足Xeon系列的龐大需求。
但供應瓶頸不只在晶圓製造。管理層指出，Intel 3製程產出正逐步增加，業界先進有機基板短缺卻限制EMIB先進封裝產能，進而影響伺服器CPU交貨。
公司預估，2026年與2027年產業伺服器CPU出貨量每年將成長逾30%，供應吃緊可能延續至2027年底，甚至進入2028年。全年DCAI營收則可望較年初預期高出約100億美元。
摩根士丹利仍認為，這些強勁數字高度依賴供不應求的環境，英特爾旗艦產品相較同業依然偏弱。在AMD與Arm架構持續競爭下，英特爾能否擴大市占，仍取決於供應改善程度。
明年還要加碼投資 現金流恐轉負
英特爾季末現金及短期投資約540億美元，有息負債約501億美元。8月增資充實資金，但後續晶圓與封裝產線投資，以及代工業務虧損，仍將持續消耗現金。
公司維持2026年資本支出毛額約200億美元的預估，2027年則將大幅增加，確切金額尚未敲定。辛斯納直言，明年將是投資年，自由現金流很可能無法維持正值。
第三季調整後自由現金流為16億美元，但這項正向表現未必能延續至明年。摩根士丹利認為，即使後續財務預估上修，目前股價也已大致反映相關利多。
英特爾眼前的難題是，PC業務已開始拖累營運，代工收入卻仍缺乏明確時間表。伺服器需求雖強，供應限制與持續增加的投資，讓市場更難單憑尚未兌現的轉型前景買單。
paras_en: Intel (INTC-US) saw data‑center revenue post its strongest growth in 15 years, but that could not mask the pressure from a weakening PC market and an uncertain foundry outlook. Higher memory prices are suppressing upgrade demand, and the company forecasts client‑side revenue to fall more than 20% in Q4, with no clear timeline for large external foundry orders. The financial outlook fell short of expectations, and with capital spending set to surge next year, free cash flow could turn negative, dragging the stock down nearly 30% during Friday’s (30th) session.

The market’s disappointment this time centers not on the current quarter’s earnings but on the forward operating outlook. The PC slowdown is expected to continue at least into the first half of next year, the foundry business remains loss‑making, and capital expenditures are slated to rise sharply next year. Even strong server orders are unlikely to offset concerns about the pace of transformation and cash‑flow pressures.
PC Weakness Leads to Over 20% Revenue Decline Forecast for Q4

Client‑side business (CCPG), which focuses on PC and laptop processors, posted Q3 revenue of $8.097 billion, down 5% year‑over‑year and 9% quarter‑over‑quarter, missing company expectations; operating profit was $2.285 billion, yielding an operating margin of about 28%.

Client‑side remains Intel’s largest revenue source, yet the company projects Q4 revenue to decline another >20% quarter‑over‑quarter. CFO Dave Zinsner said the PC market slowdown will last at least through the first half of next year, with inventory adjustments extending into Q1.
Intel estimates the overall PC addressable market will shrink about 12% by volume in 2026, with the second half seeing a decline of over 20%; a further ~10% reduction is possible in 2027.

Rising memory prices are a key factor dampening demand. While data‑centers are still willing to pay higher prices for memory, the PC market faces higher system costs, reducing consumers’ willingness to upgrade and dragging down processor sales.
Morgan Stanley estimates that continued deterioration in the client‑side business could force a downward revision of consensus revenue estimates by roughly $3‑$4 billion.
Quarterly Profit Beats Estimates, but Next‑Quarter Guidance Misses

Intel reported Q3 revenue of $16.513 billion, up 21% year‑over‑year and roughly in line with market expectations of about $16.5 billion; adjusted earnings were $0.52 per share, above the market’s roughly $0.40 estimate and higher than the company’s own prior guidance of about $0.38.

However, the company projects Q4 revenue of only $15‑$16 billion, below the market’s roughly $17.1 billion expectation; adjusted earnings are forecast at $0.25 per share, also missing the market’s roughly $0.43 estimate.

An explosion at Intel’s Fab 28 plant in Kiryat Gat, Israel, early this month halted production for about two weeks and disrupted supply of some 10‑nm server products. Zinsner said the incident is preliminarily estimated to shave roughly $300 million off Q4 revenue and cut gross margin by about two percentage points, with similar effects possible in Q1 next year.
Most wafer‑scrap losses will be booked in Q4. Nonetheless, compared with the plant incident, weak PC sales are the primary reason the Q4 outlook fell short of market expectations.
Foundry Hopes Remain but Customer Timelines Remain Unclear
Former CEO Pat Gelsinger pushed the IDM 2.0 strategy, hoping Intel’s fabs would not only serve internal products but also take external orders and receive investment to catch up on advanced nodes.

After Pat Gelsinger’s successor, Pat Fritz, took over, the market briefly speculated that he might scale back the foundry business to improve financial performance, yet he continues to prioritize it. Following a $23 billion stock raise in August, investors are looking for supply improvements, 18A capacity gains, and concrete external customer orders.

Nevertheless, Q3 foundry revenue was $6.697 billion, with the vast majority still coming from internal orders. External revenue rose modestly by $118 million to $411 million, driven mainly by one‑off customer projects, while the segment posted an operating loss of $1.853 billion.

During the earnings call, Bank of America directly asked when external customers would move from evaluation to actual production—i.e., complete design and hand over to the fab—and when related revenue could be incorporated into financial guidance.

Pat Fritz did not disclose customer details, only noting that packaging business may see customers announce news in the next two quarters; regarding 18A and 14A, no clear timelines or revenue estimates were provided.
Can Advanced Nodes Secure Large Orders? Still Unproven
SemiAnalysis notes that while Intel’s 18A has shipped, its transistor density does not lead the comparable TSMC node, and high‑end GPUs and I/O chips still rely on TSMC capacity.
Morgan Stanley believes market confidence in Intel’s foundry hinges on the 14A node being in production by 2028‑2029, yet large‑scale external commitments remain limited at present.

The firm also worries about Intel’s structural capability gaps, arguing that if Intel cannot even meet its own product demand, it will struggle to win external customers. For the foundry transition, securing sustained, sizable orders after a node’s launch remains a critical test.
Strong Server Orders but Supply Lags Behind

Intel’s Q3 data‑center and AI (DCAI) revenue was $7.318 billion, up 78% year‑over‑year and 17% quarter‑over‑quarter; operating profit was $3.039 billion, yielding an operating margin of about 42%, surpassing client‑side profitability.
Pat Fritz said that despite short‑term headwinds for the PC industry, CPU demand remains robust and the top priority is to increase supply to meet the massive demand for Xeon processors.

However, supply constraints extend beyond wafer fabrication. Management noted that output from Intel 3 is gradually increasing, but a shortage of advanced organic substrates limits EMIB advanced‑packaging capacity, affecting server‑CPU deliveries.

The company forecasts that industry server‑CPU shipments will grow over 30% annually in 2026 and 2027, with tight supply potentially persisting through the end of 2027 and into 2028. Full‑year DCAI revenue could be about $10 billion higher than early‑year expectations.

Morgan Stanley still argues that these strong numbers rely heavily on a supply‑demand imbalance, and Intel’s flagship products remain relatively weak versus peers. With AMD and Arm architectures continuing to compete, Intel’s ability to gain market share will depend on how quickly supply improves.
Investments to Ramp Up Next Year; Cash Flow May Turn Negative

Intel’s quarter‑end cash and short‑term investments total roughly $54 billion, with interest‑bearing debt of about $50.1 billion. The August capital raise bolstered liquidity, but ongoing wafer and packaging line investments and foundry losses will continue to drain cash.

The company maintains a 2026 capital‑expenditure outlook of roughly $20 billion, with a substantial increase slated for 2027, though the exact amount is not yet set. CFO Zinsner bluntly said next year will be an investment year and free cash flow is likely to turn negative.

Adjusted free cash flow in Q3 was $1.6 billion, but this positive result may not carry over into next year. Morgan Stanley believes that even if later financial guidance is raised, the stock price already reflects most of the upside.

Intel’s immediate challenge is that the PC business is already dragging on operations while foundry revenue still lacks a clear timeline. Server demand is strong, but supply constraints and rising investment make it harder for the market to bet on an unproven transformation outlook.

items.title: 超賣訊號？谷歌股價出現「死亡交叉」 過去5次有4次半年後反而漲
items.title_en: Oversold Signal? Google Stock Shows a "Death Cross" – 4 of the Last 5 Occurrences Rose Six Months Later
paras: 投資人對Alphabet(GOOGL-US) 的人工智慧（AI）策略抱持疑慮，股價數月來持續走低。如今，第三季財報不如預期，更引發周四(29日)股價創下歷來最大單日跌幅，並觸發被稱為「死亡交叉」的技術面偏空訊號。
死亡交叉是指股價短期均線跌破長期均線，通常以50日簡單移動平均線跌破200日簡單移動平均線為判斷依據。這代表Alphabet近期股價表現，已明顯弱於過去一年大部分時間的走勢。
截至周三，Alphabet的50日均線已連續319個交易日維持在200日均線之上。不過，隨著財報顯示核心搜尋業務成長放緩，這項紀錄在周四畫下句點。
根據FactSet數據，Alphabet的50日均線降至340.26美元，跌破200日均線的340.93美元。自10月初以來，Alphabet股價已下跌近18%。
不過，包括死亡交叉在內的均線交叉訊號，未必適合用來判斷進出場時機，因為這類訊號往往早有跡可循。
均線根據歷史收盤價計算，屬於落後指標，其作用在於確認某種走勢已持續夠久、幅度夠大，或兩者兼具，足以視為長期趨勢。
死亡交叉雖可能意味跌勢將延續，但Alphabet過往並非總是如此。根據道瓊市場數據，過去10年，Alphabet股價曾出現5次死亡交叉，其中4次在6個月後股價走高，平均漲幅為21.9%。
Alphabet上一次出現死亡交叉是在2025年4月8日，當時股價已在兩個月內，自先前的歷史收盤高點重挫29.9%。巧合的是，死亡交叉出現當天，正好也是該波跌勢觸底之日。
再前一次則發生於2022年3月9日，當時股價較4個月前創下的歷史高點下跌11%。那波跌勢直到8個月後、也就是2022年11月3日才觸底，期間又下跌37.5%。
另一項技術指標則顯示，市場對Alphabet的悲觀情緒可能正接近高峰。
該股14日相對強弱指標（RSI）已降至23.1，為2011年6月以來最低。RSI是衡量股價變動速度與幅度的動能指標，用以判斷個股是否處於超買或超賣狀態。
交易員通常將RSI降至30或以下，視為個股遭遇強烈賣壓、股價已低於合理價值的訊號。
paras_en: Investors have been skeptical of Alphabet (GOOGL-US)'s artificial intelligence (AI) strategy, and the stock has been trending lower for months. Now, a weaker-than-expected third‑quarter earnings report triggered the biggest single‑day drop in the stock’s history on Thursday (the 29th) and set off a bearish technical signal known as a “death cross.”

A death cross occurs when a short‑term moving average falls below a long‑term moving average, typically judged by the 50‑day simple moving average crossing below the 200‑day simple moving average. This indicates that Alphabet’s recent price performance has been clearly weaker than most of the past year’s trend.

As of Wednesday, Alphabet’s 50‑day moving average had stayed above the 200‑day line for 319 consecutive trading days. However, with earnings showing a slowdown in its core search business, that streak ended on Thursday.
According to FactSet data, Alphabet’s 50‑day average slipped to $340.26, breaking below the 200‑day average of $340.93. Since early October, the stock has fallen nearly 18%.
However, moving‑average cross signals—including the death cross—are not necessarily reliable for timing entry or exit, because such signals often have precedents that can be observed earlier.

Moving averages are calculated from historical closing prices and are lagging indicators; they serve to confirm that a trend has persisted long enough, moved enough, or both, to be considered a long‑term trend.

While a death cross can suggest a continued decline, Alphabet’s history does not always follow that pattern. Dow Jones market data show that in the past ten years the stock has experienced five death crosses, and in four of those cases the price rose within six months, averaging a 21.9% gain.

The most recent death cross for Alphabet occurred on April 8, 2025, when the stock had already fallen 29.9% from a prior historical high within two months. Coincidentally, that day also marked the bottom of that decline.

The previous occurrence was on March 9, 2022, when the price was 11% lower than the historical high set four months earlier. That decline didn’t bottom until eight months later, on November 3, 2022, during which the stock fell an additional 37.5%.
Another technical indicator suggests that market pessimism toward Alphabet may be nearing its peak.

The stock’s 14‑day Relative Strength Index (RSI) has dropped to 23.1, the lowest level since June 2011. RSI measures the speed and magnitude of price changes to gauge whether a stock is overbought or oversold.
Traders typically view an RSI at or below 30 as a signal that a stock is under heavy selling pressure and may be priced below its fair value.

items.title: 拒絕為戰爭服務！全球113個港口掀罷工潮
items.title_en: Refusing to Serve War! Strikes Sweep 113 Ports Worldwide
paras: 歐洲等地多國碼頭工人30日（周五）發動罷工，導致部分港口航運和渡輪服務受影響，罷工者抗議港口被用於運輸武器，並對從波斯灣到黑海的衝突海域不斷有海員喪生表達不滿。
據《路透社》報導，此次罷工涉及22個國家，113個港口。參與者還要求提高工資、改善工作條件，並為途經戰區的船舶有醫生隨行。
「我們不會為他們的戰爭工作，更不會成為他們的炮灰。」希臘商船工程師工會主席阿波斯托洛斯·基普拉約斯當天在比雷埃夫斯港舉行的集會上表示。
他說道：「我們對此深有體會，家人也是如此，家人時刻擔心我們的同事能否平安歸來。」
目前已有超過25個工會支持罷工，最初這場罷工由義大利、法國、希臘、西班牙巴斯克地區、土耳其和摩洛哥發起。
今天（30日）罷工波及比雷埃夫斯、瓦倫西亞、勒阿弗爾、阿爾赫西拉斯和熱那亞等主要航運樞紐，以及摩洛哥丹吉爾地中海港和印度那瓦舍瓦港。
「海員傷亡慘重，死傷數百人。」希臘海員工會PENEN在一份聲明中表示。
該工會稱，10月前21天，波斯灣地區發生28起針對船隻的襲擊，為伊朗戰爭爆發以來最高紀錄。今年迄今，黑海地區已確認發生570起襲擊，造成40名海員死亡，數百人受傷。
印度WTWFI工會代表說，約15名印度海員因伊朗戰爭死亡，更多人因水道被封鎖而困在海上。
一個名為「不為種族滅絕提供港口」的碼頭工人和活動人士團體，致力於阻止軍事貨物抵達以色列港口。該團體稱，此次抗議將導致約5.2萬個貨櫃停運，涉及貨物價值28億美元。
paras_en: Port workers in Europe and other regions launched a strike on Friday the 30th, disrupting some shipping and ferry services at several ports. The strikers protest the use of ports for transporting weapons and express anger over the continual loss of seafarers in conflict zones from the Persian Gulf to the Black Sea.
According to Reuters, the strike involves 22 countries and 113 ports. Participants also demand higher wages, better working conditions, and that ships passing through war zones have doctors on board.
"We will not work for their war, nor will we become their cannon fodder," said Apostolos Kipraios, chairman of the Greek Merchant Marine Engineers Union, at a rally in the port of Piraeus on the day.
He added, "We know this all too well, as do our families, who constantly worry whether our colleagues will return safely."
More than 25 unions have so far backed the strike, which was initially launched by unions in Italy, France, Greece, Spain’s Basque region, Turkey and Morocco.

Today (the 30th) the strike affects major shipping hubs such as Piraeus, Valencia, Le Havre, Algeciras and Genoa, as well as the Mediterranean port of Tangier in Morocco and the Indian port of Navsava.
"Seafarer casualties are staggering, with hundreds killed or injured," the Greek seafarers’ union PENEN said in a statement.

The union reported that in the 21 days before October there were 28 attacks on vessels in the Persian Gulf – the highest number since the outbreak of the Iran war – and that to date this year the Black Sea has seen 570 confirmed attacks, killing 40 seafarers and wounding hundreds.
A representative of India’s WTWFI union said about 15 Indian seafarers have died in the Iran war and many more are stranded at sea due to blocked waterways.

A dockworkers and activist group called “Ports Not for Genocide” is working to stop military cargo from reaching Israeli ports, claiming the protest will halt roughly 52,000 containers, affecting goods worth $2.8 billion.

items.title: 美國抗通膨債券年利率升至5.51%！固定利率創近20年新高
items.title_en: U.S. Inflation‑Protected Bond Annual Yield Rises to 5.51% – Fixed Rate Hits Highest Level in Nearly Two Decades
paras: 美國財政周五(30日)部宣布，新一輪I系列儲蓄債券(I bonds)綜合年利率升至5.51%，高於前一期的4.26%，適用於2026年11月1日至2027年4月30日新購買的債券。其中，固定利率提高至1.40%，創2006年以來最高，讓這項抗通膨工具再度受到關注。
新利率由反映通膨的浮動部分4.08%，以及固定部分1.40%組成，依公式計算並四捨五入後，綜合年利率為5.51%。這項利率適用於買入後首六個月，並不代表持有半年就能獲得5.51%的報酬。
I系列債券利率曾在2022年5月升至9.62%的歷史高點，吸引投資人買進。隨後通膨降溫、利率下滑，不少短期投資人選擇贖回，如今通膨再度升溫，可能吸引資金回流。追蹤抗通膨債券的網站Tipswatch.com創辦人David Enna表示，I系列債券目前的吸引力明顯提高。
美國9月消費者物價指數(CPI)年增3.7%，高於8月的3.4%。經濟學家指出，伊朗戰爭推升汽油與能源成本，川普關稅、AI資料中心建設及旅遊需求也增添物價壓力。紐約聯準銀行調查則顯示，9月消費者對未來一年通膨的預期升至3.9%，創逾三年新高。
財政部每年5月與11月調整I系列債券利率，浮動部分依據六個月的CPI變化計算；固定利率則在買入時確定，之後持有期間維持不變。財政部並未公開固定利率的計算方式，因此市場難以準確預測其調整幅度。
對既有持有人而言，浮動利率會依原始購買月份，每六個月更新一次，不會在財政部公布新利率時立即同步調整；原有固定利率也不會改為此次的1.40%。
I系列債券最長可計息30年，但買入後至少須持有一年才能贖回；若未滿五年就贖回，將損失最後三個月的利息。
paras_en: The U.S. Treasury announced on Friday (the 30th) that the composite annual rate for the new series of I‑Savings Bonds (Series I) has risen to 5.51%, up from the previous 4.26%. The rate applies to bonds purchased between November 1, 2026 and April 30, 2027. The fixed‑rate component has increased to 1.40%, the highest since 2006, drawing renewed attention to this inflation‑hedging tool.

The new rate consists of a 4.08% inflation‑adjusted variable component and a 1.40% fixed component; after applying the Treasury’s formula and rounding, the composite annual yield is 5.51%. This rate applies only for the first six months after purchase and does not mean holders will earn a 5.51% return for a full six‑month holding period.

Series I bond yields peaked at a historic 9.62% in May 2022, prompting strong investor demand. As inflation cooled and rates fell, many short‑term investors redeemed their bonds. With inflation heating up again, capital may flow back in. David Enna, founder of the inflation‑bond tracking site Tipswatch.com, said the Series I bonds are now markedly more attractive.

U.S. consumer prices rose 3.7% year‑over‑year in September, above August’s 3.4% increase. Economists noted that the war in Iran lifted gasoline and energy costs, while Trump‑era tariffs, AI data‑center construction and travel demand added further price pressure. A New York Fed survey showed September’s one‑year‑ahead inflation expectations rose to 3.9%, a three‑year high.

The Treasury adjusts Series I bond rates each May and November. The variable component is calculated from the six‑month CPI change, while the fixed component is set at purchase and remains unchanged for the life of the bond. The Treasury does not disclose the formula for the fixed rate, making it difficult for the market to predict future adjustments accurately.

For existing holders, the variable rate is updated every six months based on the original purchase month and does not change immediately when the Treasury announces a new rate. The fixed rate that was locked in at purchase also remains unchanged and does not switch to the new 1.40% rate.

Series I bonds can earn interest for up to 30 years, but they must be held for at least one year before redemption. If redeemed before five years, the investor forfeits the interest earned in the last three months.

items.title: 美國一周借8390億美元創紀錄！借新還舊壓力浮上檯面
items.title_en: U.S. Sets Record with $839 Billion Borrowed in One Week, Highlighting Re‑Funding Pressures
paras: 美國政府本周透過11場公債標售籌得8,390億美元，創下單周歷史新高，反映龐大到期債務與財政赤字帶來的融資需求。不過，這筆資金大多用於償還到期債務，實際新增借款僅1,060億美元，並未接近歷史紀錄。
根據《彭博》周五(30日)報導，本周標售涵蓋短期國庫券、浮動利率債券，以及2年、5年與7年期公債，總規模超越去年同期創下的8,340億美元紀錄。其中，大部分資金用於償還到期短期國庫券持有人，其餘則提供政府額外資金，以支應聯邦赤字。
若觀察單周淨新增借款，歷史高點出現在2020年3月至4月。當時美國政府為支應疫情因應措施，大幅擴增公債標售規模，單周淨籌資額最高接近3,620億美元，遠高於本周的1,060億美元。因此，創紀錄的標售總額，並不代表政府本周新增同等規模的債務。
每周發債總額主要隨到期債務規模而大幅變動，但此次紀錄也凸顯，累積債務與融資成本上升，正推動美國政府進行規模愈來愈大的公債標售。
Mischler Financial Group利率銷售與交易董事總經理Tony Farren表示，財政部單周發債總額創新高並非好事，最大的風險在於投資人可能要求更高的美債殖利率，才願意承接這些債券。
過去兩年，美國財政部主要透過擴大每周短期國庫券標售，滿足不斷增加的借款需求，同時維持每月七場、涵蓋2年至30年期中長期公債的標售規模不變。
然而，這種做法終究需要調整，否則短期國庫券占整體債務的比重可能持續上升。由於短債到期頻率較高，政府必須更頻繁地重新融資，一旦利率上升，增加的利息負擔也會更快反映在納稅人的負擔上。
自2024年初以來，財政部在季度政策聲明中持續表示，預期至少未來幾季維持中長期公債標售規模不變。債市策略師預期，財政部11月4日公布下一份聲明時，將調整這項指引，為後續發債安排釋出新訊號。
paras_en: The U.S. government raised $839 billion this week through 11 Treasury auctions, a historic weekly high that reflects the massive financing needs driven by maturing debt and fiscal deficits. However, most of the proceeds were used to repay maturing obligations, so net new borrowing was only $106 billion, far short of a record.

According to Bloomberg on Friday the 30th, the week’s auctions covered short‑term Treasury bills, floating‑rate notes, and 2‑, 5‑ and 7‑year bonds, bringing total issuance above last year’s record of $834 billion. The bulk of the cash went to settle maturing short‑term bill holders, with the remainder providing extra funding for the federal deficit.

Looking at net new borrowing per week, the historical peak occurred in March‑April 2020, when the government dramatically expanded auction sizes to fund pandemic response, reaching a weekly net raise of nearly $362 billion—much higher than this week’s $106 billion. Thus, the record‑setting total auction amount does not imply an equally large increase in debt issuance this week.

Weekly issuance totals swing sharply with the amount of debt coming due, but this record also underscores that the growing stock of debt and financing costs are pushing the Treasury to conduct ever‑larger auctions.

Tony Farren, Managing Director of Interest Rate Sales and Trading at Mischler Financial Group, warned that the Treasury’s record weekly issuance is not a positive sign; the biggest risk is that investors may demand higher yields on U.S. Treasuries before they are willing to take on the bonds.

Over the past two years, the Treasury has mainly met rising borrowing needs by expanding weekly short‑term bill auctions while keeping the schedule of seven monthly auctions for 2‑ to 30‑year intermediate‑ and long‑term bonds unchanged.

However, that approach will eventually need to be adjusted, or the share of short‑term bills in total debt could keep rising. Because short‑term debt matures more frequently, the government must refinance more often, and any rise in rates would quickly translate into higher interest costs for taxpayers.

Since the start of 2024, the Treasury’s quarterly policy statements have consistently said it expects to keep the size of intermediate‑ and long‑term bond auctions steady for at least the next few quarters. Bond‑market strategists anticipate that the Treasury’s next statement on November 4 will revise this guidance, signaling a new direction for future issuance plans.

items.title: 美國加薪追不上物價！勞動成本增幅連兩季輸給通膨
paras: 美國第三季勞動成本季增0.8%，符合市場預期，較第二季的0.9%略為放緩，顯示薪資帶來的通膨壓力相對溫和。不過，勞動成本增幅已連續兩季落後物價漲幅，反映即使就業市場大致穩定，勞工購買力仍受到侵蝕。
美國勞工統計局(BLS)周五(30日)公布，涵蓋薪資與福利支出的就業成本指數(ECI)，第三季季增0.8%；截至9月的12個月則上升3.4%，與截至6月的年增幅相同。扣除通膨後，第三季就業成本較去年同期下降0.4%。
ECI是衡量勞動成本最全面的指標，由於能調整就業結構與職位品質變化的影響，被政策制定者視為評估勞動市場鬆緊程度及預測核心通膨的重要依據。最新數據顯示，雇主整體用人成本仍在上升，但薪資成長並未進一步加速。
進一步觀察薪資部分，非軍職勞工第三季薪資季增率小幅降至0.7%，年增率則降至3.1%，為2021年以來最低。若扣除物價上漲影響，截至9月的12個月，實質薪資下降0.6%，顯示薪資增加仍不足以抵銷生活成本攀升。
薪資成長放緩的情況遍及多個產業，包括營建業及休閒餐旅業。就更廣泛的服務類職務而言，薪資年增率也降至2016年以來最低，凸顯薪資成長動能轉弱並非僅限於少數領域。
然而，福利支出仍對雇主構成壓力。民間企業雇主的醫療福利成本，截至9月的12個月增加6.4%，追平2005年以來最高增幅，與薪資成長降溫形成對比。
今年美國勞動市場大致維持穩定，裁員不多，但企業招募活動也偏低迷。聯準會(Fed)主席華許周三在央行宣布維持利率不變後表示，就業增加與勞動力成長步調一致，失業率變化不大，但通膨仍處於高檔。
這使政策面臨兩項不同訊號：薪資增幅放緩，有助減輕勞動成本帶來的通膨壓力；但整體物價仍持續擠壓家庭預算。BLS下周將公布10月就業報告，為市場提供美國招募活動與薪資走勢的最新線索。

items.title: 台中銀統籌主辦23億元聯貸 支持崇偉營造承攬高雄市舊市議會都更工程
items.title_en: Taichung Bank Leads NT$2.3 B Syndicated Loan to Support Chong‑Wei Construction’s Kaohsiung Old City Council Urban Renewal Project
paras: 台中銀行統籌主辦崇偉營造工程股份有限公司承攬之「高雄市舊市議會公辦都市更新案新建工程主體工程」新台幣23億元聯合授信案，攜手合作金庫商業銀行、臺灣中小企業銀行及全國農業金庫共同主辦，並邀請高雄銀行參與授信，於10月28日舉行簽約典禮，由台中銀行副總經理陳淑貞代表銀行團，與崇偉營造董事長潘大興完成簽約，展現金融同業攜手合作、支持重大建設的具體成果。
本案工程由台灣人壽參與推動之高雄市舊市議會公辦都市更新案所衍生，崇偉營造承攬其中主體工程。高雄市舊市議會公辦都市更新案為高雄市重要的都市更新計畫，基地位於高雄市前金區中正路一帶，座落於亞洲資產管理中心高雄專區。
該案透過公辦都市更新機制，結合歷史場域保存與都市機能再造，除規劃保留及修復原高雄市議會歷史建築，亦將導入現代化辦公及產業空間，期打造融合歷史文化、金融發展與城市機能的多元化都市環境。
本案以「新舊共榮」為發展理念，透過歷史建築與新建築的整合，以及開放空間與綠化環境設計，提升整體都市景觀與空間使用效益。未來隨著相關建設逐步推進，期能結合金融服務、科技產業及創新服務等發展方向，促進區域產業發展，為高雄舊城區注入新的發展動能。
台中銀行秉持支持企業發展、服務實體經濟的經營理念，積極整合金融資源，透過聯合授信機制，攜手合作金庫商業銀行、臺灣中小企業銀行、全國農業金庫及高雄銀行共同參與本案，提供工程建設所需資金，支持崇偉營造推動主體工程，並展現金融同業協力支持都市更新與城市建設的合作精神。
台中銀行長期深耕企業金融市場，持續以多元化金融服務滿足企業融資需求，並關注都市更新、永續發展及重大建設所帶動的金融服務機會。未來將持續發揮金融專業與資源整合能力，深化與企業及金融同業的合作，支持國內建設發展與產業升級，為地方經濟成長及城市轉型貢獻金融力量。
paras_en: Taichung Bank acted as the lead arranger for a NT$2.3 billion joint credit facility for Chong‑Wei Construction Co., Ltd.’s contract to build the main structures of the Kaohsiung Old City Council public‑sector urban renewal project. The loan was co‑organized with Cooperative Bank, Taiwan Small and Medium Enterprise Bank and the National Agricultural Credit Union, and Kaohsiung Bank was invited to participate. The signing ceremony was held on October 28, with Taichung Bank’s deputy general manager Chen Shu‑chen signing on behalf of the banking syndicate and Chong‑Wei Construction chairman Pan Da‑xing completing the agreement, showcasing concrete results of inter‑bank cooperation in supporting major construction.

The project stems from the Kaohsiung Old City Council public‑sector urban renewal scheme promoted by Taiwan Life Insurance, with Chong‑Wei Construction awarded the main works. The renewal plan is a key urban redevelopment initiative for Kaohsiung, located in the Qianjin District along Zhongzheng Road, within the Kaohsiung zone of the Asia Asset Management Center.

Through the public‑sector urban renewal mechanism, the scheme combines historic site preservation with urban function revitalisation. It plans to retain and restore the historic Kaohsiung City Council building while introducing modern office and industrial spaces, aiming to create a diversified urban environment that blends heritage, financial development and city functions.

The development concept is “prosperity of old and new,” integrating historic structures with new construction and incorporating open and green spaces to enhance the overall cityscape and spatial efficiency. As construction progresses, the project aims to link financial services, technology industries and innovative services, spurring regional industrial growth and injecting new development momentum into Kaohsiung’s historic district.

Taichung Bank, adhering to its philosophy of supporting corporate development and serving the real economy, actively aggregates financial resources through the syndicated loan mechanism. Together with Cooperative Bank, Taiwan Small and Medium Enterprise Bank, National Agricultural Credit Union and Kaohsiung Bank, it will provide the funding needed for construction, support Chong‑Wei Construction’s main works, and demonstrate the collaborative spirit of financial institutions in backing urban renewal and city building.

Taichung Bank has long cultivated the corporate finance market, continuously offering diversified financial services to meet corporate financing needs while focusing on opportunities arising from urban renewal, sustainable development and major projects. Going forward, it will keep leveraging its financial expertise and resource‑integration capabilities to deepen cooperation with corporations and peer banks, supporting domestic construction and industrial upgrading, and contributing financial strength to local economic growth and urban transformation.

items.title: 金惠奫出任台灣觀光代言人 觀光署攜國航及韓國旅遊業者搶攻來台市場
items.title_en: Kim Hye-eun Appointed Taiwan Tourism Ambassador; Tourism Bureau Teams with Korean Airlines and Tour Operators to Target Taiwan Market
paras: 為拓展韓國觀光市場，搶攻聖誕節、明(2027)年春節及第1季旅遊商機，交通部觀光署在韓國首爾舉辦新年度台灣觀光代言人暨宣傳影片記者會，由署長陳玉秀頒發委任書，邀韓國人氣演員金惠奫(ㄩㄣ)擔任台灣觀光代言人，並公開全新宣傳影片。觀光署為展現台灣多元旅遊魅力，此次深化與韓國重要旅行業者及航空公司的合作，希望透過明星宣傳、旅遊優惠及產業通路合作，吸引更多韓國旅客來台。
陳玉秀此次訪韓也與韓國旅遊產業交流，除了拜會我國駐韓國台北代表部丘高偉大使，並舉辦觀光推廣會，邀韓國旅行業協會(KATA)李振錫會長、首爾觀光協會趙泰淑會長、及HANA TOUR、MODE TOUR、黃色氣球等韓國重要組團旅行業者與華航(2610-TW)、長榮(2618-TW)等航空公司代表，共同研商韓國出境旅遊市場趨勢及擴大來台送客合作機會。
觀光署表示，會中除了介紹台灣最新觀光亮點，也向韓國業者說明觀光雙輪驅動方案、MICE獎勵旅遊及各項優惠措施，期望結合韓國主要旅行社的市場通路與航空運輸資源，推動更多元的臺灣旅遊產品，積極爭取自由行、團體旅遊及企業獎勵旅遊客源，讓觀光宣傳與旅遊產品銷售相互帶動，擴大韓國旅客來台動能。
陳玉秀表示，台韓航程便利、文化交流密切，臺灣不僅擁有豐富的自然景觀、特色美食與城市文化，更有溫暖的人情味及休閒療癒的生活氛圍，此次邀請金惠奫小姐擔任代言人，正是看中她親切、自然且充滿活力的形象，與韓國民眾喜愛的「台灣感性」十分契合。
此次全新影片以「台灣百Ways」為概念，透過金惠奫細膩而多變的演出，呈現姊弟、親子、好友及獨旅等不同旅行情境，讓韓國旅客看見台灣適合不同世代、期待吸引更多旅客一來再來，每次都能發掘不一樣的台灣。
paras_en: To expand into the Korean tourism market and capture travel opportunities around Christmas, the 2027 Lunar New Year, and the first‑quarter tourism season, the Ministry of Transportation and Communications’ Tourism Bureau held a press conference in Seoul, South Korea, to announce the new Taiwan tourism ambassador and unveil a promotional video. The bureau chief, Chen Yu‑hsu, presented the appointment letter and invited popular Korean actress Kim Hye‑eun (金惠奫) to serve as Taiwan’s tourism ambassador, unveiling a brand‑new promotional film. By deepening cooperation with major Korean travel agencies and airlines, the bureau aims to attract more Korean visitors through star power, travel discounts, and industry channel partnerships, showcasing Taiwan’s diverse travel appeal.

During the same visit, Chen Yu‑hsu met with Taiwan’s representative office in Korea, led by Ambassador Chiu Kao‑wei, and held a tourism promotion forum. Attendees included KATA President Lee Jin‑seok, Seoul Tourism Association President Cho Tae‑sook, and representatives from major Korean tour operators such as HANA TOUR, MODE TOUR, and Yellow Balloon, as well as airline representatives from China Airlines (2610‑TW) and EVA Air (2618‑TW). The gathering discussed trends in outbound Korean travel and explored opportunities to expand outbound‑to‑Taiwan collaborations.

The Tourism Bureau said the meeting introduced Taiwan’s latest tourism highlights and explained the “dual‑wheel” tourism development plan, MICE incentive travel, and various discount measures to Korean partners. The goal is to combine Korean travel agencies’ market channels with airline transport resources to promote a broader range of Taiwanese tourism products, actively seeking independent travelers, group tours, and corporate incentive travel, thereby creating a virtuous cycle between promotion and product sales and boosting Korean visitor momentum to Taiwan.

Chen Yu‑hsu noted that the convenient air links and close cultural exchanges between Taiwan and Korea make the island an attractive destination. Taiwan not only boasts rich natural scenery, distinctive cuisine, and vibrant city culture, but also warm hospitality and a relaxing, therapeutic lifestyle. He said Kim Hye‑eun was chosen for her friendly, natural, and energetic image, which aligns perfectly with the “emotional Taiwan” that Korean people love.

The new video, built around the concept “Taiwan 100 Ways,” showcases Kim Hye‑eun’s nuanced and versatile performances across various travel scenarios—siblings, parent‑child, friends, and solo travelers—allowing Korean audiences to see that Taiwan suits every generation. The aim is to attract more visitors to return repeatedly, discovering a different side of Taiwan each time.

items.title: 〈聯發科法說〉首顆AI ASIC放量Q4貢獻上修至25億美元 明年衝160億高標、市占拚2成
items.title_en: MediaTek Earnings Call: First AI ASIC Volume Boosts Q4 Revenue Forecast to $2.5 B, Targets $16 B High End in 2027, Aiming for 20% Market Share
paras: IC設計大廠聯發科(2454-TW)執行長蔡力行今(30)日於法說會表示，首款AI加速器ASIC已於9月開始出貨初期訂單，受惠客戶需求強勁，預估第四季雲端ASIC營收可達25億美元；展望2027年，該專案營收可望達原訂目標區間高標、約160億美元，約占整體AI加速器ASIC市場20%。
蔡力行指出，第四季雲端ASIC營收上修主要來自客戶需求強勁，聯發科也持續與供應鏈夥伴合作爭取額外產能，其中基板是目前較具挑戰性的供應環節。不過，團隊已成功整合多個領域的供應商，對供應展望具信心，並將持續擴大產能以滿足客戶需求。
至於第二個AI加速器ASIC專案，蔡力行表示，目前開發進度符合預期，部分晶粒已完成流片，較大型、複雜的晶粒也將按計畫完成流片，僅因晶片規模及複雜度較高，時程較其他晶粒多約2至3週。新一代晶片在效能及每瓦效能上均有大幅提升，並可顯著降低客戶總擁有成本(TCO)，公司對專案進展及競爭力具信心。
對於2028年營運展望，蔡力行表示，雖然目前供應鏈仍有不少變數，尚不便提供具體營收指引，但預期2028年將是另一個由需求帶動的強勁成長年。此外，聯發科已確認取得第二家雲端ASIC客戶，新專案正陸續展開，預計2028年開始貢獻營收。
除ASIC晶片開發外，聯發科也持續推進448G SerDes、3.5D先進封裝及共封裝光學(CPO)等關鍵技術，並透過與輝達合作的NVLink Fusion夥伴計畫，將客戶ASIC連結至NVLink生態系統，同時支援UALink乙太網路架構機櫃，從晶片進一步延伸至系統及機櫃解決方案，擴大資料中心市場布局。
paras_en: MediaTek (2454‑TW) CEO Tsai Li‑xing said at today’s earnings call that the first AI accelerator ASIC began shipping initial orders in September and, driven by strong customer demand, the company now expects cloud ASIC revenue in Q4 to reach $2.5 billion. Looking ahead to 2027, the project’s revenue is projected to hit the upper end of its original target range, about $16 billion, roughly 20% of the overall AI accelerator ASIC market.

Tsai explained that the Q4 cloud ASIC revenue lift comes mainly from robust customer demand. MediaTek is also working with supply‑chain partners to secure extra capacity, with substrates currently being the most challenging component. The team has successfully integrated suppliers across multiple domains, is confident about supply outlook and will continue expanding capacity to meet customer needs.

Regarding the second AI accelerator ASIC project, Tsai said development is on schedule, with some dies already having completed tape‑out. Larger, more complex dies will also finish tape‑out as planned, though they require about two to three weeks longer than the smaller ones due to size and complexity. The next‑generation chips deliver substantial gains in performance and performance‑per‑watt and can markedly lower customers’ total cost of ownership, giving the company confidence in the project’s progress and competitiveness.

On the 2028 operating outlook, Tsai noted that while the supply chain still has many variables that prevent a concrete revenue guide, the company expects 2028 to be another strong growth year driven by demand. MediaTek has also confirmed a second cloud ASIC customer, with the new project rolling out and expected to start contributing revenue in 2028.

Beyond ASIC development, MediaTek continues to advance key technologies such as 448‑Gbit SerDes, 3.5D advanced packaging and co‑packaged optics (CPO). Through Nvidia’s NVLink Fusion partner program, it links customer ASICs to the NVLink ecosystem and supports UALink Ethernet‑based rack architectures, extending from chips to system and rack solutions to broaden its data‑center market footprint.

items.title: 台灣金聯25週年！啟動永續三安2.0 宮文萍：組國家隊跨足不動產控股
items.title_en: Taiwan Jinlian Celebrates 25th Anniversary, Launches Sustainable San'an 2.0; Gong Wen‑ping: Building a National Team to Expand into Real‑Estate Holding
paras: 台灣金聯今(30)日舉辦25週年慶祝茶會，現場冠蓋雲集，董事長宮文萍於致詞時宣布啟動「居住正義永續三安」2.0版，強調未來將以「居住正義國家隊」為定位，推動公司由資產處置業者轉型為具備完整產業鏈的「不動產控股公司」。
今日茶會產官界重磅貴賓齊聚，包括財政部次長阮清華、金管會副主委陳彥良、內政部次長董建宏及創辦人前財政部長林振國等人均親自出席，共同見證台灣金聯成立四分之一個世紀的新里程碑。
宮文萍指出，「永續三安」2.0版在於全面升級政策服務量能，都更方面，民眾端提供全案管理與前期資金墊付，建商端則提供續建資金承諾，防範爛尾樓風暴；包租代管則結合安養信託擴大社宅參與；平價住宅更推出「婚育宅」及尾款分期，降低青年成家門檻。近期更獲選為新北市住都中心「文山靜」公辦都更最優申請人，展現專業實力。
回顧25年發展歷程，宮文萍表示，台灣金聯經歷三大階段轉型：從早期收購2,880億元不良債權的「金融秩序穩定期」，到成功活化屏東老埤農場、台東知本金聯世紀酒店等大宗資產的「資產活化期」，如今已全面進入「居住正義實踐期」。
在落實政策目標同時，台灣金聯亦繳出亮眼財務成績單。截至2025年，累計發放現金股利已達股東投資額的168.42%，平均年獲利率7.32%；截至2026年9月，公司淨值達177.84億元、總資產衝上278.18億元，雙雙創下近14年來新高。此外，平價住宅開辦16年來已協助1,096戶家庭順利成家。
展望未來，宮文萍強調，台灣金聯將持續結合子公司業務，厚植資產整合實力，朝向具備完整產業鏈的「綜合型不動產控股集團」邁進，擴大市場領先優勢。
paras_en: Taiwan Jinlian held a 25th‑anniversary celebration tea party today (30th), attended by a crowd of dignitaries. In her speech, Chairperson Gong Wen‑ping announced the launch of the “Sustainable San'an 2.0” version of the “Housing Justice” initiative, emphasizing that the company will reposition itself as a “National Team for Housing Justice” and transform from an asset‑disposal operator into a fully integrated real‑estate holding company.

The tea party gathered top guests from government and industry, including Deputy Minister of Finance Ruan Qinghua, Vice Chair of the Financial Supervisory Commission Chen Yanliang, Deputy Minister of the Interior Dong Jianhong, and former Finance Minister Lin Zhanguo, all attending in person to witness this quarter‑century milestone for Taiwan Jinlian.

Gong explained that the Sustainable San'an 2.0 upgrade expands policy and service capacity across the board: on the urban renewal side, the company will provide full‑project management and upfront financing for residents, while offering continuation‑fund commitments to developers to prevent unfinished‑building crises; rental‑management will be combined with senior‑care trusts to broaden participation in public housing; affordable housing will feature “marriage‑and‑childbirth homes” and installment payments for final balances to lower the threshold for young families. Recently the firm was selected as the top applicant for New Taipei City’s “Wenshan‑Jing” public‑sector urban renewal project, showcasing its professional strength.

Looking back over 25 years, Gong said Taiwan Jinlian has undergone three major transformation phases: an initial “financial order stabilization” period during which it purchased NT$288 billion of non‑performing loans, a “asset revitalization” period marked by successful redevelopment of large‑scale assets such as the old Pi Farm in Pingtung and the Jinlian Century Hotel in Taitung, and now a full‑scale “housing‑justice implementation” phase.

While pursuing its policy goals, Taiwan Jinlian has also delivered strong financial results. By the end of 2025, cumulative cash dividends reached 168.42 % of shareholders’ invested capital, with an average annual return of 7.32 %; as of September 2026, the company’s net worth stood at NT$17.784 billion and total assets rose to NT$27.818 billion, both hitting fourteen‑year highs. In addition, over the past 16 years the affordable‑housing program has helped 1,096 households successfully start families.

Looking ahead, Gong stressed that Taiwan Jinlian will continue to integrate its subsidiaries’ businesses, deepen its asset‑integration capabilities, and move toward becoming a “comprehensive real‑estate holding group” with a complete industry chain, thereby expanding its market‑leadership advantage.

items.title: 賴清德：三大方向協助產業布局全球 續推榮邦計畫助企業組「聯合艦隊」
items.title_en: Lai Ching-te: Three Key Directions to Help Industries Deploy Globally, Continuing the Rongbang Initiative to Form “Joint Fleets” for Companies
paras: 賴清德總統今(30)日出席由民間產業基金會、電電公會舉辦的「榮邦啟航 鏈動全球 經濟外交高峰論壇」時表示，面對全球經貿新局，台灣產業須更深入參與供應鏈整合，完善海外布局，政府持續推動榮邦計畫，協助企業組成「聯合艦隊」，打造海外聚落、深化與當地產業合作，並透過經濟外交降低投資障礙，協助中小微企業轉型升級。
賴清德表示，政府將在既有合作基礎上持續推動榮邦計畫，將台灣在基礎建設、人才培育及科技發展等方面的經驗，帶往友邦與更多理念相近國家，並從3個方向協助產業布局全球，包括單打獨鬥走向整體出擊、設廠走向扎根、由政府擔任企業後盾，
賴清德指出，當前地緣政治、科技發展及經濟安全考量，正全面改變全球經貿秩序，企業布局海外，不僅要考量市場、成本與生產效率，更必須兼顧供應鏈韌性、人才資源、能源條件，及與當地產業長期合作的能力，台灣具備資通訊產業實力、精密製造技術及科學園區等產業聚落發展經驗，在全球供應鏈中持續占有不可或缺的關鍵地位。
賴清德表示，台灣產業若要走得更遠，必須從個別產品出口模式升級，更深入參與供應鏈整合，建構完整海外布局，這不僅是企業經營模式的轉變，更是台灣面對全球經貿新局必須掌握的戰略方向。
賴清德強調，政府將在既有合作基礎上持續推動榮邦計畫，將台灣在基礎建設、人才培育及科技發展等方面的經驗，帶往友邦與更多理念相近國家，並從以下3個方向協助產業布局全球。
首先是從單打獨鬥走向整體出擊。賴清德表示，台灣企業已具備赴海外投資設廠能力，下一階段要朝更廣面向發展，政府將持續串聯各部會專業及資源，協助產業升級轉型，並由大型企業帶領供應鏈上下游廠商組成「聯合艦隊」，打造海外聚落，以團隊方式進軍世界。
其次是從設廠走向扎根，產業布局不僅要廣也要深，企業除建立生產據點，更要連結當地研發、人才與市場，將台灣的技術及管理經驗與當地產業優勢結合，建立緊密合作關係，促進雙贏發展。
第三是由政府擔任企業後盾。賴清德表示，產業布局除了廣度與深度，也需要速度，這正是政府做為企業後盾所要展現的力量，也詳細說明「AI新十大建設」計畫、「支持及壯大中小微企業方案」的政策內容與投入經費，全力強化創新與競爭力。
賴清德說，當我們實力更穩固、海外布局更完整，台灣將不只是全球供應鏈的參與者，也更能成為海外產業生態系的建構者，攜手國際夥伴共創全球繁榮發展。
paras_en: President Lai Ching-te attended today’s “Rongbang Sets Sail, Chains the World, Economic Diplomacy Summit” hosted by a private industry foundation and the Electrical and Electronics Association, saying that in the face of new global trade dynamics, Taiwan’s industries must deepen participation in supply‑chain integration and perfect overseas deployment. The government will keep pushing the Rongbang plan to help firms form “joint fleets,” build overseas clusters, deepen cooperation with local industries, and use economic diplomacy to lower investment barriers, assisting SMEs in transformation and upgrading.

Lai said the government will build on existing cooperation to continue the Rongbang plan, taking Taiwan’s experience in infrastructure, talent cultivation and technology development to friendly and like‑minded countries, and will assist industries in global deployment from three angles: moving from solo efforts to coordinated attacks, shifting from merely setting up factories to rooting them, and having the government act as a corporate backer.

He noted that current geopolitics, technological advances and economic‑security considerations are reshaping the global trade order. When expanding overseas, companies must consider not only market size, cost and production efficiency but also supply‑chain resilience, talent resources, energy conditions and the ability to cooperate long‑term with local industries. Taiwan’s strengths in ICT, precision manufacturing and science‑park clusters give it an indispensable role in global supply chains.

Lai stressed that for Taiwan’s industries to go farther, they must upgrade from a product‑by‑product export model to deeper supply‑chain integration and a comprehensive overseas footprint. This is not just a shift in business models but a strategic direction Taiwan must master amid new global trade realities.

He reiterated that the government will continue the Rongbang initiative on the basis of existing partnerships, exporting Taiwan’s expertise in infrastructure, talent development and technology to friendly and ideologically aligned nations, and will assist global industry placement through the three aforementioned directions.

First, moving from solo efforts to coordinated attacks. Lai said Taiwanese firms already have the capability to invest and set up factories abroad; the next stage is broader development. The government will keep linking ministries’ expertise and resources to help industries upgrade, with large corporations leading upstream and downstream suppliers to form “joint fleets” that create overseas clusters and enter the world as a team.

Second, shifting from merely setting up factories to rooting them. Industry placement must be both wide and deep; firms should not only establish production sites but also connect with local R&D, talent and markets, blending Taiwan’s technology and management experience with local strengths to build close partnerships and promote win‑win growth.

Third, the government acting as a corporate backer. Lai explained that beyond breadth and depth, speed is essential, and that is where government support shines. He detailed the “AI New Ten Major Projects” and the “Support and Strengthen SMEs” policies, including funding, to fully boost innovation and competitiveness.

He concluded that when Taiwan’s capabilities are more solid and its overseas footprint more complete, the island will not only be a participant in global supply chains but also a builder of overseas industry ecosystems, working with international partners to create shared global prosperity.

items.title: 物價持穩有底氣！國發會葉俊顯：全年CPI維持約2% 經濟成長率可望再上調
items.title_en: Steady Prices Give Confidence! NDC Chair Yeh Chun-Hsien: CPI Around 2% All Year, Economic Growth May Be Revised Upward
paras: 國發會主委葉俊顯今(30)日出席「經濟外交高峰論壇」致詞時強調，政府正積極推動AI新十大建設，打造全民智慧生活圈，發揮台灣在半導體與資通訊產業的優勢，作為帶動出口、投資與消費三強鼎立的重要引擎。隨全球供應鏈重組與雲端服務需求擴增，今年台灣經濟成長率展現極佳韌性，全年CPI將維持在2%左右，下月主計總處發布最新預測時，今年經濟成長率有相當高的機會再向上調升。

全球經濟今年呈現溫和趨勢，受地緣政治衝突、美中關稅變數及極端氣候等風險干擾，國際機構預估全球經濟成長率落在2.4%至3.1%之間。儘管面臨全球通膨與利率高企等不確定性，台灣經濟依然乘風破浪。葉俊顯指出，受惠於全球雲端服務業者擴大資本支出，半導體與資通訊產品出口表現極佳；國內業者亦同步擴增先進製程與產能，帶動投資大幅成長。加上股市屢創新高的財富效果與民生消費復甦，出口、投資與消費三強，成為撐起台灣經濟高成長的三大支柱。
物價方面，受颱風及蔬果價格影響，今年1月至9月CPI平均為1.94%，全年預估將維持在2%左右。葉俊顯分析，在經濟強勁成長與總需求推升下，物價維持在2%左右屬健康且正常的溫和現象，政府亦會透過相關穩定措施密切控管。
在產業布局上，國發會統籌的「AI新十大建設」，涵蓋智慧應用、關鍵技術與數位基盤三大區塊。葉俊顯表示，AI發展正從生成式晶片轉向代理式晶片，未來機器與電腦間將能自主對話，深度融入食衣住行育樂及醫療等領域。為推動百工百業AI化，政府訂定明確目標：製造業AI普及率預計於2028年提升至50%，服務業亦將透過AI應用紓解少子化與缺工難題。
關鍵技術領域則鎖定矽光子、量子科技與機器人三大核心。葉俊顯形象比喻，量子是算力的大腦，晶片是心臟，矽光子則是神經，三者結合能實現高階機器人與Physical AI應用。為避免國內矽光子驗證耗時受制於國外，台灣將建置自主驗證實驗室；量子國家隊亦將進階為國際隊，打造自主可控的國家級算力中心。
此外，為充實創新創業資金鏈，國發會會同各部會推出8隻百億產業投資基金，健全新創各階段的資金供給，並於矽谷與東京設立海外新創基地。葉俊顯強調，台灣在全球新創生態系指數已首度躋身前20名，政府將善用科技基礎與非紅供應鏈優勢，鞏固台灣在全球供應鏈中的關鍵地位。
paras_en: National Development Council (NDC) Chair Yeh Chun-Hsien said today (30th) at the Economic Diplomacy Summit that the government is actively promoting ten new AI initiatives to create a nationwide smart lifestyle ecosystem, leveraging Taiwan’s strengths in semiconductors and ICT as a key engine to boost exports, investment and consumption. With global supply‑chain reshoring and expanding cloud‑service demand, Taiwan’s economy has shown strong resilience this year; the CPI is expected to stay around 2% for the full year, and when the Directorate‑General of Budget, Accounting and Statistics releases its latest forecast next month, there is a good chance the growth rate will be revised upward.

The global economy this year is showing a moderate trend, but faces risks from geopolitical conflicts, US‑China tariff uncertainties and extreme weather. International agencies project world growth between 2.4% and 3.1%. Despite global inflation and high interest rates, Taiwan’s economy continues to press forward. Yeh noted that Taiwan benefits from increased capital spending by global cloud providers, leading to excellent semiconductor and ICT export performance; domestic firms are also expanding advanced processes and capacity, driving strong investment growth. Combined with the wealth effect of a stock market that repeatedly hits new highs and a revival in consumer spending, the three pillars of export, investment and consumption are supporting Taiwan’s high‑growth trajectory.

On prices, the CPI averaged 1.94% from January to September, affected by typhoons and fresh‑produce costs, and is projected to stay around 2% for the year. Yeh explained that with robust economic growth and rising total demand, a CPI near 2% is a healthy, normal moderate level, and the government will closely manage prices through relevant stabilization measures.

Regarding industrial strategy, the NDC’s coordinated “Ten New AI Projects” cover three blocks: smart applications, key technologies and digital infrastructure. Yeh said AI development is shifting from generative chips to proxy chips, enabling machines and computers to converse autonomously and become deeply embedded in food, clothing, housing, transportation, education, entertainment and healthcare. To AI‑ify all industries, the government has set clear targets: AI adoption in manufacturing is expected to reach 50% by 2028, and the service sector will use AI to alleviate low birth rates and labor shortages.

Key technology focus areas are silicon photonics, quantum technology and robotics. Yeh likened quantum to the brain of computing power, chips to the heart, and silicon photonics to the nerves; together they can enable advanced robots and Physical AI applications. To avoid dependence on foreign verification for silicon‑photonic devices, Taiwan will build its own verification lab; the national quantum team will be upgraded to an international level to create a sovereign, controllable national‑scale computing center.

In addition, to strengthen the innovation‑entrepreneurship financing chain, the NDC together with other ministries is launching eight hundred‑billion‑NTD industry investment funds to support all stages of startups, and establishing overseas innovation hubs in Silicon Valley and Tokyo. Yeh emphasized that Taiwan has entered the top‑20 globally for startup ecosystem indices for the first time, and the government will leverage its tech foundation and non‑red‑supply‑chain advantages to cement Taiwan’s critical role in the global supply chain.

items.title: 八貫前3季每股賺5.7元、賺贏去年全年 新訂單排到明年Q2後
items.title_en: Baguang Posts EPS of NT$5.7 for First Three Quarters, Beats Full-Year 2025 Profit; New Orders Booked Through Q2 2027
paras: TPU材料大廠八貫(1342-TW)自結今(2026)年第3季財報，受惠於戶外與醫療擴大應用領域，再加上航太航海與軍工客戶強勁拉貨及標案出貨貢獻雙重助攻下，單季EPS達1.6元，累計前3季EPS為 5.7元，已賺贏去(2025)年全年度獲利。八貫主管也表示，目前與客戶洽談的新訂單均已排到明(2027)年第2季後，展現營運成長動能及強勁的訂單能見度。
八貫今年第3季受惠於戶外與醫療擴大應用領域、軍工客戶強勁拉貨與標案出貨貢獻下，單季營收9.4億元、年增53.78％，因公司具備規模經濟加上產線調配優化，也帶動單季毛利率季增1個百分點為25.15％，單季營業利益為1.5億元、稅後純益1.2億元，年增分別為46.13％與17.68％，繳出第3季EPS 為1.6元，也優於去年1.34元。
統計八貫前3季營收28.6億元、年增36％，是公司四大產品線前3季營收較去年同期均雙位數成長，戶外前3季營收年增50.8％尤其亮眼，其次為醫療與軍工產品，前3季營收年增均超越二成，航太航海年增亦達14％；另於業外匯兌收益挹注1,154萬元，使稅後純益4.4億元、年增40.2％，繳出前3季EPS為5.7元，也已提前超越去年全年5.62元。
八貫指出，公司憑藉四大產品線高利基寡占市場優勢，隨著產品應用擴大與新增客戶帶動公司營運規模化發展，維持高訂單能見度，目前與客戶洽談的新訂單均已排到明年第2季以後，展現營運長遠動能。
展望今年全年度，八貫表示，今年營收成長趨勢將維持前3季年增逾3成表現，第4季於營收具備規模經濟，將藉由優化產線降低營業成本，以及不再有一次性費用影響下，單季毛利率可期，希望能爭取獲利成長空間，為2026年獲利再戰新高。
paras_en: TPU material giant Baguang (1342‑TW) reported its Q3 2026 earnings, benefiting from expanded outdoor and medical applications as well as strong pull‑through and project shipments from aerospace, marine and defense customers. EPS for the quarter was NT$1.6 and cumulative EPS for the first three quarters reached NT$5.7, already surpassing the full‑year profit for 2025. Management also said that all new orders currently under discussion with customers are scheduled beyond Q2 2027, demonstrating operational growth momentum and strong order visibility.

In Q3 2026 Baguang saw revenue of NT$9.4 billion, up 53.78% year‑over‑year, driven by outdoor and medical expansion and robust demand from defense customers. Thanks to economies of scale and production line optimization, the quarterly gross margin rose one percentage point to 25.15%. Operating profit was NT$1.5 billion and net profit after tax NT$1.2 billion, up 46.13% and 17.68% respectively, and EPS was NT$1.6, better than last year’s NT$1.34.

For the first three quarters, revenue totaled NT$28.6 billion, a 36% year‑over‑year increase. All four product lines posted double‑digit growth; outdoor revenue jumped 50.8% year‑over‑year, especially strong, followed by medical and defense products each growing over 20%, while aerospace and marine grew 14%. Foreign‑exchange gains added NT$11.54 million, lifting net profit to NT$4.4 billion, up 40.2%, and EPS to NT$5.7, already exceeding last year’s full‑year NT$5.62.

Baguang highlighted that its four high‑margin product lines give it a niche market advantage. As product applications expand and new customers come aboard, the company’s scale of operations grows, maintaining high order visibility. All new orders under negotiation are booked beyond Q2 next year, showing long‑term operational momentum.

Looking ahead to the full year, Baguang expects revenue growth to remain above the more‑than‑30% year‑over‑year pace seen in the first three quarters. In Q4, with scale economies, production line optimization to reduce operating costs, and the absence of one‑off expenses, the quarterly gross margin is expected to improve, providing room for profit growth and aiming to push 2026 earnings to new highs.

items.title: 蕭美琴提出無人機三大發展方向 打造100%非紅、信賴台灣供應鏈
paras: 副總統蕭美琴今(30)日出席「2026無人機國際論壇暨無人機國際學院開幕」時表示，政府將無人系統視為國家戰略的最優先事項之一，致力打造世界級的「無人機國家隊」，強化自我防衛與戰略嚇阻能力，未來持續透過打造非紅、值得信賴的供應鏈、發展邊緣運算與軟體定義創新，推動國際夥伴關係與「無人機外交」等三大核心支柱，鞏固台灣作為無人機民主供應鏈的亞洲中心。
蕭美琴表示，無人機的應用遠遠超越了國防部與海巡署的範疇，台灣在農業、交通、教育、公共基礎設施及其他領域也有許多民生應用，發展無人機產業需要跨部會合作，參與的機關包括經濟部、數位發展部，也有中科院、工研院等政府支持的機構，包括國安會及其他政府機關也積極投入，協調跨部會合作，確保無人機的應用、市場開發、生產，以及打造無人機國家隊所涉及的相關技術工作都能相互整合。
此外，蕭美琴表示，雖然台灣投入無人載具領域的時間較部分國家晚，但國家在半導體、精密工程及先進製造方面的優勢，讓我們能夠迅速迎頭趕上。臺灣無人機產業已加速成長，今(2026)年上半年的出口額就已超越去年一整年。
蕭美琴也強調，國防政策與產業發展藍圖相互配合，以打造世界級的「無人機國家隊」，同時強化自我防衛與戰略嚇阻能力，並帶來促進國內產業參與及成長的附加效益，我們的策略是結合安全需求、民間創新與國際合作，擴大產業規模並提升產能。
蕭美琴也提出，無人機發展藍圖以三大核心支柱為基礎：首先，打造百分之百非紅、值得信賴的供應鏈，台灣致力提供百分之百非紅供應鏈，確保微處理器、飛行控制器、光學酬載及電池，在資通安全及系統運作完整性方面，均符合最高標準。
第二，發展邊緣運算與軟體定義的創新。軟體如今已成為無人機技術差異化的關鍵。臺灣正將邊緣運算整合至自主運作平臺，使其具備即時決策、感測器融合，以及在全球定位系統(GPS)訊號失效時的導航能力。我們運用半導體與人工智慧生態系的優勢，為夥伴提供次世代平台。
第三，推動國際夥伴關係與「無人機外交」。台灣無法單獨建立這條供應鏈，在建構國內生態系的同時，透過共同研發、技術移轉、共同生產及採購，積極推動全球合作。

items.title: 科技巨頭AI魔法正在褪色 華爾街年終行情面臨艱難考驗
items.title_en: Tech Giants' AI Magic Fades as Wall Street Faces Tough Year‑End Test
paras: 華爾街原本期待，在人工智慧(AI)投資題材支撐下，科技巨頭財報可以帶動第3季財報預期上修，沒想到本周揭露的業績表現不如預期，這股期待如今開始消退，整體市場也開始顯露疲態，讓今年最後兩個月的行情增添變數。
Alphabet(GOOGL-US)周四(29日)股價暴跌近13%，創上市以來史上最大單日跌幅，加上科技巨頭同業微軟(MSFT-US)股價小幅下跌，拖累美股大幅走低。
標普500指數(SPX)10月估僅小幅上漲1%，9月下跌0.45%。那斯達克綜合指數(COMP)10月則估跌2.2%。
目前已公布財報的「科技七巨頭」業績令人失望，而接下來幾周即將公布財報的企業，也未能讓市場清楚判斷AI投資的實際成效。這顯示AI題材對市場的影響力正逐漸減弱。
同一時間，市場背景中的重大風險正在累積，包括伊朗戰爭、聯準會(Fed)可能被迫升息，以及美國消費者開始感受到通膨加速與就業不安全感揮之不去的衝擊。這些因素都讓股市在多頭行情邁入第五年之際面臨挑戰。
Fifth Third Wealth Advisors投資長Chris Osmond說：「AI交易題材不一定已經失靈，但市場關注的焦點正從資本支出，擴大到執行能力與商業化變現。從長期來看，這是比較健康的發展，儘管可能造成更大的波動，也會讓大型科技公司的股價表現出現更明顯的差異。」
Questar Capital Partners投資長Richard Reyle認為，科技股交易已來到轉折點，「這勢必會造就贏家與輸家」。
他表示：「我們現在開始看得出，哪些企業在AI上的支出合理，哪些企業並非如此。科技業財報季傳達的訊息很簡單：資本支出增加，加上大規模發行股票，會引發投資人撤離相關股票。」

科技股財報驚喜不如預期 AI投資開始考驗變現能力

標普500科技類股指數(IXT)過去一個月下跌近3%，較6月初高點回落約4.8%。這使大盤受到打壓，標普500指數過去五個月僅上漲1.4%。
第3季財報季迄今已公布財報企業略高於一半，根據LSEG數據，獲利超越市場預期的幅度平均為4.5%，遠低於第4季平均約7.7%的財報「驚喜」幅度。
LSEG數據顯示，科技類股的財報驚喜幅度為4.7%，包含Alphabet在內的通訊服務類股則為負1.5%。
以企業業績不出色來解釋或許有失公允，科技業這季獲利可能仍占標普500指數整體獲利中約一半，第4季預估也將占相近比重。但科技業已不再像過去那樣，為市場帶來額外的強勁推力，這正是令人擔憂之處。
凱投宏觀(Capital Economics)金融市場首席經濟顧問John Higgins說：「我們的基本情境是，標普500指數獲利從AI革命於2002年11月開始以來就大幅成長的趨勢，到了明年將無法延續。我們懷疑這股成長動能將有一部分遭到逆轉，進而拖累整體表現。」
他說：「考量過去四年來，科技業與整體AI投資題材一直支撐美國市場，這種可能性就令人擔憂。再加上伊朗戰爭造成能源價格動盪，並持續推升通膨壓力，情況就更令人憂心。」

通膨與升息風險升高 油價恐再推升市場壓力

聯準會(Fed)本周成功避開在10月升息，但通膨數據和穩健的預期經濟成長速度，可能讓Fed無法在12月繼續按兵不動。
Plante Moran Financial投資長Jim Baird說：「經濟成長強勁，民間內需更為強勁，裁員人數仍低，通膨則仍居高不下。你還需要看到什麼，才會進一步收緊貨幣政策？」
油價目前已穩居每桶100美元以上。若在11月3日的美國期中選舉結束後，美國與以色列決定對伊朗發動更大規模、破壞力更強的攻擊，油價可能進一步攀升。
這場期中選舉也可能比傳統風險指標目前所顯示的更容易撼動市場。民調顯示，民主黨可能取得顯著進展並重新掌控眾議院，但參議院是否也會由民主黨取得多數，仍有變數。
RBC Capital Markets美股策略主管Lori Calvasina表示：「我們認為，兩黨分掌國會對股市而言屬於中性至小幅正面事件：民主黨全面勝出屬於中性至負面事件，共和黨全面勝出則屬於正面事件。」
她補充說：「不過，重要的是持續關注投票率，以及出口民調所反映的選民投票原因，了解選民為何選擇支持某一方。」

年底衝刺時間有限 標普500挑戰8000點難度升高

這些潛在逆風接連浮現，對過去四年大多依賴科技股支撐的市場而言，是一大考驗。
從現在到年底還有44個交易日，市場仍有許多工作要做。假設標普500指數要達到華爾街堅定預測的8000點，就必須在剩餘交易日平均每天上漲約6.8點。
但今年以來，該指數每日平均漲幅約為4.4點，而在科技股與AI投資題材迅速褪色的情況下，要一個動能已所剩無幾的市場達成這項目標，恐怕有些困難。
paras_en: Wall Street had originally hoped that AI‑driven investment themes would lift tech‑giant earnings and prompt an upward revision of third‑quarter forecasts, but this week’s disappointing results have dampened that optimism, leaving the broader market showing signs of fatigue and adding uncertainty to the final two months of the year.

Alphabet (GOOGL‑US) saw its stock plunge nearly 13% on Thursday (the 29th), marking the largest single‑day drop since its listing, and Microsoft (MSFT‑US) also slipped slightly, pulling U.S. equities sharply lower.
The S&P 500 (SPX) is projected to rise only about 1% in October after a 0.45% decline in September, while the Nasdaq Composite (COMP) is expected to fall 2.2% for the month.

The earnings already reported by the “Big Seven” tech companies have been disappointing, and the upcoming reports in the next few weeks do not give the market a clear view of AI’s real impact, indicating that the AI theme’s market influence is waning.

At the same time, major background risks are building up, including the Iran war, a possible forced rate hike by the Fed, and U.S. consumers feeling the sting of accelerating inflation and lingering job‑security concerns, all of which challenge the market as it enters its fifth year of a bull run.

Chris Osmond, Chief Investment Officer at Fifth Third Wealth Advisors, said: “The AI trade theme may not have completely broken down yet, but market focus is shifting from capital spending to execution capability and commercialisation. In the long run that’s a healthier development, even if it brings more volatility and makes the performance of large‑cap tech stocks diverge more sharply.”
Richard Reyle, Chief Investment Officer at Questar Capital Partners, believes tech‑stock trading has reached a turning point, “which will inevitably create winners and losers.”

He added: “We’re now starting to see which companies’ AI spending is justified and which isn’t. The message from this tech earnings season is simple: higher capex combined with large‑scale share issuances will trigger investors to pull out of the affected stocks.”

Tech‑stock earnings fell short of expectations, putting AI’s monetisation to the test. The S&P 500 Information Technology Index (IXT) has dropped nearly 3% over the past month, retreating about 4.8% from its early‑June peak, dragging the broader market down as the S&P 500 has risen only 1.4% over the last five months.

To date, slightly more than half of the companies in the Q3 earnings season have reported, and LSEG data show that earnings beat the market by an average of 4.5%, far below the roughly 7.7% “surprise” average seen in Q4 historically.
LSEG data indicate that the earnings surprise for tech stocks is 4.7%, while communication‑services stocks—including Alphabet—registered a negative 1.5% surprise.

Attributing the weak results solely to company performance may be unfair; tech earnings this quarter likely still account for about half of total S&P 500 earnings, and a similar share is expected in Q4. However, tech is no longer providing the extra thrust it once did, which is concerning.

John Higgins, Chief Economic Adviser for Capital Economics, said: “Our baseline scenario is that the profit growth the S&P 500 has enjoyed since the AI revolution began in November 2002 will not be sustainable next year. We suspect part of that growth engine will reverse, dragging overall performance down.”

He added: “Given that tech and the broader AI theme have been supporting the U.S. market for the past four years, that prospect is worrisome. Add the Iran war‑induced energy price volatility and continued inflation pressure, and the outlook looks even bleaker.”

Inflation and rate‑rise risks are rising, and oil prices could further pressure markets. The Fed managed to avoid a rate hike in October, but inflation data and a solid growth outlook may prevent it from staying on hold through December.

Jim Baird, Chief Investment Officer at Plante Moran Financial, said: “Economic growth is strong, private demand is robust, layoffs remain low, and inflation stays high. What else do you need to see before tightening monetary policy further?”

Oil is currently trading above $100 a barrel. If, after the U.S. midterm elections on November 3, the United States and Israel decide to launch a larger, more destructive attack on Iran, oil prices could climb even higher.

The midterms may also prove more market‑shaking than traditional risk gauges suggest. Polls indicate the Democrats could make significant gains and retake the House, but whether they also capture a Senate majority remains uncertain.

Lori Calvasina, Head of U.S. Equity Strategy at RBC Capital Markets, said: “We view a split Congress as a neutral‑to‑slightly‑positive event for equities; a full Democratic sweep as neutral‑to‑negative; and a full Republican sweep as positive.”
She added: “What matters is monitoring voter turnout and the reasons voters give for their choices, as reflected in exit polls, to understand the drivers behind their decisions.”

The limited time left in the year makes the S&P 500’s push toward 8,000 points increasingly difficult. These emerging headwinds pose a major test for a market that has relied heavily on tech stocks for the past four years.

With 44 trading days remaining until year‑end, the market still has work to do. To hit the Wall Street‑forecast 8,000 level, the S&P 500 would need to average about 6.8 points of gain per day for the rest of the year.
So far this year the index has averaged roughly 4.4 points per day, and with tech stocks and AI themes fading rapidly, achieving that target in a market with dwindling momentum looks doubtful.

items.title: 美股亮罕見警訊！關鍵指標飆近70年新高 兩場大熊市曾出現
items.title_en: U.S. Stocks Light Rare Warning! Key Indicator Soars to Near 70-Year High After Two Bear Markets
paras: 美股罕見警示燈亮了！衡量優質股與低品質股相對表現的「優質減劣質因子」（QMJ），今年7月大漲14.3%，創1957年以來最大單月漲幅。歷史上，單月漲幅第二、第三大的時點，分別落在2000年11月與2008年10月，正值網路泡沫與金融海嘯熊市期間，如今指標再度飆升，引發市場戒心。
這次警訊出現在低品質股經歷史上最長、最猛烈的領漲行情之後。投資研究機構Porter and Company創辦人F. Porter Stansberry認為，人工智慧（AI）狂熱催生的投機行情已出現轉折，直言「現在是謹慎的時候了」。
低品質股狂飆 AI熱潮推波助瀾
這輪低品質股跑贏優質股的行情，從2023年11月延續至2026年6月，持續時間與幅度均創紀錄。期間，做多美國最高品質企業、做空最低品質企業的投資組合累計虧損36%，是QMJ自1957年有紀錄以來最差的一段表現。
截至2026年5月的12個月，也是69年紀錄中，優質股相對表現最弱的12個月。QMJ在2023年至2025年連續三年虧損，今年前八個月仍下跌3.8%，反映投資人追逐低品質股的力道。
AI熱潮是這波行情的主要推手。根據彭博數據，高盛追蹤的虧損科技股籃子，今年前五個月大漲57%，遠超標普500指數同期的11%。成分企業逾四分之一虧損的羅素2000小型股指數，上半年也上漲22.7%，漲幅超過大盤兩倍。
Stansberry將這波行情稱為「科技驅動的垃圾股泡沫」，並指出，其規模已是有紀錄以來最大。
警示指標看什麼？獲利、成長與安全
QMJ由AQR資本管理公司創辦人Cliff Asness與同事Andrea Frazzini、Lasse Heje Pedersen於2013年提出，相關論文於2019年發表，美國市場數據可追溯至1957年7月。
這項指標以獲利能力、成長性及安全性衡量企業品質。其中，獲利能力採用六項指標，成長性觀察過去五年每股盈餘變化，安全性則綜合股價波動、資產負債表穩健程度與股東權益報酬率的波動。
QMJ每月對美國上市股票評分，買進排名最高的30%企業，同時放空排名最低的30%，採市值加權並每月調整。因此，指標上漲代表優質股相對占上風，不等於整體股市上漲。
值得留意的是，QMJ完全不考慮估值，只衡量企業品質。從1957年7月至2026年8月，優質股平均每年跑贏低品質股3.6%，但短期仍可能長時間落後。
投機狂熱退燒 市場往往面臨調整
自1957年以來，QMJ曾經歷八次跌幅超過10%的下行週期。其中，由科技狂熱推動的典型案例，包括1960年代電子與電腦熱潮、1999年網路泡沫，以及2020年電動車、加密貨幣與遠距辦公熱潮。
這三次泡沫破裂後的兩年內，優質股分別跑贏低品質股28%、68%及41%；同期整體股市報酬分別為負4.5%、負23.5%與正6.4%。最後一次仍錄得正報酬，與比較基期落在疫情崩盤後低點有關。
不過，低品質股領漲並非一律意味泡沫。重大熊市過後，央行大量注入流動性，可能讓財務脆弱、瀕臨破產的企業得以存活，帶動股價從低點反彈。1970年代、1992年、2002年及2009年，都曾出現這類情況。
本輪行情的背景則不同。標普500在此期間持續創高，低品質股的強勢主要來自AI熱潮，並非熊市過後的復甦，也不是低估值帶動的反彈。
資金轉向優質股 投機股遭重擊
如今，市場風格已出現明顯變化。除了QMJ今年7月大漲14.3%，高盛追蹤的虧損科技股籃子第三季下跌11%；先前強勢的高投機性個股也遭重創，AST SpaceMobile(ASTS-US) 下跌56%，D-Wave Quantum(QBTS-US) 下跌52%。
相較之下，高品質消費股明顯回升。自6月30日以來，寶僑(PG-US) 上漲12.9%、可口可樂(KO-US) 上漲17.3%、Church & Dwight(CHDN-US) 上漲12.4%，高露潔棕欖(CL-US) 也上漲6.2%，均優於標普500同期的2.3%。
Stansberry提醒，QMJ過去兩次最顯著的單月漲勢，分別出現在2000年11月與2008年10月，這段歷史對照值得警惕。隨著低品質股領漲行情逆轉，他認為，投資布局向高品質、獲利能力強的企業傾斜，可能是當前較穩健的選擇。
paras_en: U.S. stocks have lit a rare warning light! The "Quality Minus Junk factor" (QMJ), which measures the relative performance of high‑quality versus low‑quality stocks, jumped 14.3% in July, the biggest single‑month gain since 1957. Historically, the second‑ and third‑largest monthly gains occurred in November 2000 and October 2008, during the dot‑com bubble and the financial‑crisis bear markets, and the indicator’s new surge is raising market caution.

The warning follows the longest and most intense rally ever seen for low‑quality stocks. Porter and Company founder F. Porter Stansberry says the AI‑driven speculative frenzy is turning a corner and bluntly advises, "Now is the time for caution."
Low‑quality stocks surge, fueled by the AI hype

This rally in which low‑quality stocks outperformed high‑quality stocks ran from November 2023 through June 2026, setting records for both duration and magnitude. Over that period, a long‑short portfolio that bought the highest‑quality U.S. firms and shorted the lowest‑quality firms lost 36%, the worst performance for the QMJ since records began in 1957.

The 12‑month period ending May 2026 also marks the weakest 12‑month relative performance of high‑quality stocks in the 69‑year record. The QMJ posted losses for three consecutive years from 2023 to 2025 and was down another 3.8% in the first eight months of this year, reflecting the strength of investors chasing low‑quality stocks.

The AI boom is the main driver of this rally. Bloomberg data show that the loss‑making tech‑stock basket tracked by Goldman Sachs surged 57% in the first five months of the year, far outpacing the S&P 500’s 11% gain over the same period. More than a quarter of the constituents of the Russell 2000 small‑cap index, which is dominated by loss‑making firms, rose 22.7% in the first half, more than double the broad market’s rise.
Stansberry calls this wave a "technology‑driven junk‑stock bubble" and notes that its size is the largest on record.
What does the warning indicator look at? Profitability, growth and safety

The QMJ was introduced in 2013 by Cliff Asness of AQR Capital Management together with Andrea Frazzini and Lasse Heje Pedersen, with the related paper published in 2019. U.S. market data for the factor go back to July 1957.

The metric evaluates corporate quality on profitability, growth and safety. Profitability is measured by six indicators, growth looks at five‑year earnings‑per‑share changes, and safety combines price volatility, balance‑sheet strength and equity‑return volatility.

Each month the QMJ scores all U.S. listed stocks, buying the top‑30% and shorting the bottom‑30%, using market‑cap weighting and rebalancing monthly. Therefore, a rise in the index means high‑quality stocks are relatively stronger, not that the overall market is up.

It is worth noting that the QMJ ignores valuation entirely and only measures quality. From July 1957 through August 2026, high‑quality stocks have outperformed low‑quality stocks by an average of 3.6% per year, though short‑term periods can see prolonged underperformance.
Speculative frenzy cools, markets often face corrections
